Representing 87.7% of the total, the Distribution segment remains the largest contributor to the Company's net revenues. Net revenues from this segment increased by Rp 1.7 trillion, or 23.9%, compared to the previous year. This performance was primarily driven by higher sales of principal products, the addition of several new principals, and the growing contribution of sales through the digital platform PPGOS. The gross profit margin remained strong at 7.7%, supported by effective product portfolio management.

Mewakili 87,7% dari total, segmen Distribusi tetap menjadi kontributor terbesar bagi pendapatan neto Perseroan. Pendapatan neto dari segmen ini meningkat sebesar Rp 1,7 triliun, atau 23,9%, dibandingkan dengan tahun lalu. Kinerja ini terutama disebabkan oleh peningkatan penjualan produk prinsipal, penambahan beberapa prinsipal baru serta semakin meningkatnya kontribusi penjualan dari platform digital PPGOS. Margin laba kotor tetap kuat di angka 7,7%, berkat pengelolaan portofolio produk yang baik.

Net Revenue of the Professional Products Division in 2024 increased by 21.6% compared to 2023, driven primarily by the strong performance of Imboost Force (an immune-boosting supplement), as the public increasingly sought to maintain their health by consuming immunity-enhancing supplements. This growth was also supported by a shift in consumer behavior following the COVID-19 pandemic, with greater awareness and attention to personal health. This trend positively impacted the sales of products within the Professional Products Division, including skincare products, which contributed to the sales growth of Noroid and Asthin. Both products benefited from robust support through e-commerce services and sales channels in 2024. Additionally, in 2024, the division recorded incremental sales from newly launched products, namely Imboost Force Cough Syrup for Adults and Boost Protekid for children. The division also expanded its Noroid product range by introducing more economical packaging in smaller sizes.

The Consumer Health segment recorded a net revenue increase of 13.9% at year-end, reaching Rp 490.6 billion and contributing approximately 4.9% to the Company's total net revenue. This growth was primarily driven by the strong performance of Imboost, which gained increasing recognition among consumers through television advertisements and digital marketing efforts. Imboost is widely trusted to enhance the immune system, especially with the innovative Imboost Extra variant, which is enriched with vitamins C and D and available in both tablet and effervescent forms. Another factor supporting sales growth in this segment was the positive performance of Curcuma Plus Vitamin, which benefited from expanded distribution in retail pharmacies as well as increased online sales through e-commerce platforms.

Net revenue from the Alliance segment increased by 13.8% compared to 2023. This growth was primarily supported by the launch of new products such as Mycophen and Tacsograf, as well as higher sales of Pramifrol and Soroquin, which were listed in the national e-catalogue. Additionally, the performance of Flutison also contributed positively to the segment's overall sales growth.

Net revenues from the Others segment decreased by 0.4%, mainly due to a decrease in revenue from sales of Unihealth products.

### Financial Accounting Standards Nomenclature

### Amendments of PSAK 201 (previously referred to as PSAK 1): Non-current Liabilities with Covenants.

The amendments specify the requirements for classifying liabilities as current or non-current and clarify:

- what is meant by a right to defer settlement,
- the right to defer must exist at the end of the reporting period,
- classification is not affected by the likelihood that an entity will exercise its deferral right, and
- only if an embedded derivative in a convertible liability is an equity instrument would be terms and conditions of a liability will not impact its classification.

In addition, a requirement has been introduced to require disclosure when a liability arising from a loan agreement is classified as non-current and the entity's right to defer settlement is contingent on compliance with future covenants within twelve months.

### Amendemen PSAK 201 (sebelumnya dirujuk sebagai PSAK 1): Liabilitas Jangka Panjang dengan Kovenan.

### Amendemen ini menentukan persyaratan untuk mengklasifikasikan suatu liabilitas sebagai jangka pendek atau jangka panjang dan menjelaskan:

- hal yang dimaksud sebagai hak untuk menangguhkan pelunasan,
- hak untuk menangguhkan pelunasan harus ada pada akhir periode pelaporan,
- klasifikasi tersebut tidak dipengaruhi oleh kemungkinan entitas akan menggunakan haknya untuk menangguhkan liabilitas, dan
- hanya jika derivatif melekat pada liabilitas konversi tersebut adalah suatu instrumen ekuitas, maka syarat dan ketentuan dari suatu liabilitas konversi tidak akan berdampak pada klasifikasinya.

Selain itu, persyaratan telah diperkenalkan untuk mewajibkan pengungkapan ketika suatu kewajiban timbul dari pinjaman perjanjian diklasifikasikan sebagai tidak lancar dan hak entitas untuk menunda penyelesaian bergantung pada kepatuhan terhadap persyaratan di masa depan dalam waktu dua belas bulan.

Amendments of PSAK 116 (previously referred to as PSAK 73): Lease Liability in a Sale and Leaseback.

The amendments to PSAK 116 (previously referred to as PSAK 73) Leases specify the requirements that a seller-lessee uses in measuring the lease liability arising in a sale and leaseback transaction, to ensure the seller-lessee does not recognize any amount of the gain or loss that relates to the right of use it retains.

Amendments of PSAK 207 (previously referred to as PSAK 2) and PSAK 107 (previously referred to as PSAK 60): Supplier Finance Arrangements.

The amendments to PSAK 207 (previously referred to as PSAK 2) and PSAK 107 (previously referred to as PSAK 60) clarify the characteristics of supplier finance arrangements and require additional disclosure of such arrangements. The disclosure requirements in the amendments are intended to assist users of financial statements in understanding the effects of supplier finance arrangements on an entity's liabilities, cash flows, and exposure to liquidity risk.

The implementation of standards above had no material impact to the financial reporting and disclosure in the Company's consolidated financial statements.

Amendemen PSAK 116 (sebelumnya dirujuk sebagai PSAK 73): Liabilitas Sewa dalam Jual Beli dan Sewa-balik.

Amendemen PSAK 116 (sebelumnya dirujuk sebagai PSAK 73) Sewa menetapkan persyaratan yang digunakan penjual-penyewa dalam mengukur kewajiban sewa yang timbul dalam transaksi jual beli dan sewa-balik, untuk memastikan penjual-penyewa tidak mengakui jumlah setiap keuntungan atau kerugian yang terkait dengan hak guna yang dipertahankan.

Amendemen PSAK 207 (sebelumnya dirujuk sebagai PSAK 2) dan PSAK 107 (sebelumnya dirujuk sebagai PSAK 60): Pengaturan Pembiayaan Pemasok.

Amendemen PSAK 207 (sebelumnya dirujuk sebagai PSAK 2) dan PSAK 107 (sebelumnya dirujuk sebagai PSAK 60) mengklarifikasi karakteristik pengaturan pembiayaan pemasok dan mensyaratkan pengungkapan tambahan atas pengaturan pembiayaan pemasok tersebut. Persyaratan pengungkapan dalam amendemen ini dimaksudkan untuk membantu pengguna laporan keuangan dalam memahami dampak pengaturan pembiayaan pemasok terhadap liabilitas, arus kas, dan eksposur terhadap risiko likuiditas suatu entitas.

## Commitment to Good Corporate Governance Practices

Komitmen terhadap Praktik Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

The Company is committed to operating at the highest standard of Good Corporate Governance. We want to ensure that everything our employees do is guided by our commitment to our values and is in compliance with the local laws and regulations. The foundation of these commitments are laid out in our Good Corporate Governance ("GCG") Code, which we established in October 2015 and has become the underpinning set of rules for management and employees. The GCG Code collects several key principles and provides a working guideline for how we apply our values across our operations. GCG practices are extremely important to the Company's ability to accomplish its goals.

Implementation of corporate governance in the Company has been carried out in accordance with the applicable laws and Company regulations. Each governance body operates independently and responsibly. Besides that, every decision taken has considered the GCG principles related to transparency, accountability, responsibility, independency, as well as equality and fairness.

These five principles of GCG help the Company to maintain a harmonious and ethical relationship with its shareholders and other stakeholders.

In addition, the implementation of GCG principles in business activities also support integrity, work ethics, and accountable decision-making through supervision, control activities and adequate risk management.

Based on such understanding, GCG becomes a reference for the Company to deal with increasing competition and uncertainties of the investment climate in the business world, while ensuring its long-term business continuity.

To enhance implementation quality, the Company conducts evaluation and follow-up on improvements for the implementation of GCG across its entire business portfolio.

Perseroan berkomitmen untuk beroperasi dengan standar tertinggi dari Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik. Kami ingin memastikan bahwa semua yang dilakukan karyawan kami dipimpin oleh komitmen kami terhadap nilai-nilai kami dan sesuai dengan hukum dan peraturan setempat. Dasar dari komitmen ini dituangkan dalam Kode Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik ("GCG"), yang kami tetapkan pada bulan Oktober 2015 dan telah menjadi perangkat peraturan yang mendasari bagi manajemen dan karyawan. Kode GCG berisi sejumlah prinsip utama dan memberikan pedoman kerja tentang cara kami menerapkan nilai-nilai kami di seluruh operasi Perseroan. Praktik GCG sangat penting bagi kemampuan Perseroan untuk mencapai tujuannya.

Penerapan tata kelola perusahaan di Perseroan telah berjalan sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan dan peraturan yang berlaku di Perseroan. Setiap organ tata kelola menjalankan fungsi secara independen dan bertanggung jawab. Di samping itu, setiap keputusan yang diambil telah memperhatikan prinsip-prinsip GCG terkait transparansi, akuntabilitas, responsibilitas, independensi, serta kesetaraan dan kewajaran.

Kelima asas GCG tersebut membantu Perseroan dalam menjaga hubungan harmonis yang sesuai etika dengan pemegang saham dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

Selain itu, implementasi asas GCG dalam aktivitas usaha juga mendukung integritas, etika kerja dan pengambilan keputusan yang bertanggung jawab melalui kegiatan pengawasan, pengendalian, dan pengelolaan risiko yang layak.

Berdasarkan pemahaman tersebut, GCG menjadi rujukan Perseroan untuk menghadapi ketatnya persaingan dan tidak menentunya iklim investasi di dunia usaha, serta menjaga kelangsungan usaha jangka panjang.

Untuk meningkatkan kualitas implementasinya, Perseroan senantiasa melakukan evaluasi dan tindak lanjut perbaikan terhadap penerapan GCG di seluruh lini usaha yang dijalankan.

# Good Corporate Governance
## Tata Kelola Perusahaan Yang Baik

The Company realizes that the implementation of good corporate governance will be able to support accountability and increase the success of the Company's business. The implementation of good corporate governance is also expected to increase the value of the Company as well as create a good and superior image for the Company in the future. Therefore, the Company is committed to implementing good corporate governance thoroughly in every aspect of the Company's functions with reference to all relevant regulations.

Based on Law No. 40 of 2007 on Limited Liability Companies as amended by Law No. 6 of 2023 on Job Creation, the corporate governance mechanism regulates the pattern of relationships and structures between the Company's main organs consisting of the GMS, the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, as well as other supporting organs, namely the Audit Committee, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Internal Audit Unit, and the Corporate Secretary.

This structure is established to ensure the implementation of corporate governance principles in a systematic manner by clearly defining the roles and responsibilities of each organ of the Company.

The GMS is the highest organ in the corporate governance structure. The GMS is a company organ with an exclusive authority that cannot be delegated to other organs, as long as its roles and decisions are still in accordance with the Limited Liability Company Law and/or the Articles of Association of the Company. The GMS is a forum for shareholders to formulate important decisions by taking into account the interests of the Company, as well as considering the provisions in the Company's Articles of Association and all applicable rules and regulations.

Perseroan menyadari bahwa penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik akan mampu mendukung akuntabilitas dan peningkatan keberhasilan usaha Perseroan. Adanya penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik diharapkan juga dapat meningkatkan nilai Perseroan dan menciptakan citra yang baik dan unggul bagi Perseroan di masa akan datang. Oleh karenanya, Perseroan berkomitmen untuk menerapkan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik secara menyeluruh di dalam setiap aspek fungsi Perseroan dengan mengacu pada seluruh peraturan yang terkait.

Berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas sebagaimana telah diubah dengan Undang-Undang No. 6 Tahun 2023 tentang Cipta Kerja, mekanisme tata kelola perusahaan mengatur pola hubungan dan struktur antara organ utama Perseroan yang terdiri dari RUPS, Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan juga organ pendukung lainnya, yakni Komite Audit, Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi, Unit Audit Internal, dan Sekretaris Perusahaan.

Struktur ini ditetapkan guna memastikan pelaksanaan prinsip tata kelola perusahaan secara sistematis dengan ditentukannya secara jelas mengenai peran dan tanggung jawab masing-masing organ Perseroan.

RUPS merupakan organ tertinggi dalam struktur tata kelola Perseroan. RUPS menjadi organ perusahaan dengan kewenangan eksklusif yang tidak dapat dilimpahkan kepada organ lain, sepanjang peran dan keputusannya masih sesuai dengan Undang-Undang Perseroan Terbatas dan/atau Anggaran Dasar Perseroan. RUPS merupakan forum bagi para pemegang saham untuk memformulasikan keputusan-keputusan penting dengan memperhatikan kepentingan Perseroan, serta mempertimbangkan ketentuan-ketentuan dalam Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan seluruh ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku.

Meanwhile, the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors are jointly responsible for the continuity of the Company's business in the long term. The management of the Company is carried out by the Board of Directors, while the Board of Commissioners is responsible for supervising the performance of the management of the Company conducted by the Board of Directors. Therefore, the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors must have a shared perception of the Company's vision, mission and values to be achieved.

The implementation of the tasks and responsibilities of the two organs are supported by their respective supporting organs. The Board of Commissioners is assisted by the Audit Committee, and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Meanwhile, the Board of Directors is assisted by the Corporate Secretary and the Internal Audit Unit.

Sementara itu, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi secara bersama-sama bertanggung jawab atas kelangsungan usaha Perseroan dalam jangka panjang. Pengelolaan Perseroan dilakukan oleh Direksi, sementara Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan pengawasan terhadap kinerja pengelolaan Perseroan oleh Direksi. Oleh karena itu, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi harus memiliki kesamaan persepsi terhadap visi, misi, dan nilai-nilai Perseroan yang ingin dicapai.

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab kedua organ tersebut didukung oleh organ pendukung masing-masing. Dewan Komisaris dibantu oleh Komite Audit dan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi, Sedangkan Direksi dibantu oleh Sekretaris Perusahaan dan Unit Audit Internal.

# General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS)

## Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS)

The GMS is the primary mechanism to protect and exercise the rights of shareholders. As an organ of the Company, the GMS holds the ultimate authority over matters cannot be delegated to the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors. However, without diluting either the power or authority of the GMS, the GMS or shareholders may not intervene against the duties, functions, and authorities of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors which must be carried out in accordance with the Articles of Association and prevailing laws and regulations.

The GMS serves as a mechanism for shareholders to make important decisions regarding their investment in the Company, by observing provisions in the Articles of Association and all prevailing regulations.

In addition, in the event that the Company has a conflict of interest with the personal interests of all members of the Board of Directors and all members of the Board of Commissioners, the GMS will appoint a person or more who does not have a conflict of interest to represent the Company in carrying out the matter.

RUPS merupakan mekanisme utama untuk melindungi dan menggunakan hak-hak pemegang saham. Sebagai suatu organ Perseroan, RUPS memegang wewenang tertinggi atas hal-hal yang tidak dapat dilimpahkan kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi. Namun tanpa mengurangi kekuasaan atau wewenang RUPS, RUPS atau pemegang saham tidak dapat melakukan intervensi terhadap tugas, fungsi, dan wewenang Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang harus dijalankan sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar dan hukum dan peraturan yang berlaku.

RUPS merupakan mekanisme bagi pemegang saham untuk mengambil keputusan penting terkait dengan penyertainya di Perseroan, dengan memperhatikan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan semua peraturan yang berlaku.

Di samping itu, dalam hal Perseroan mempunyai benturan kepentingan dengan kepentingan pribadi seluruh anggota Direksi dan seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris, maka RUPS akan mengangkat seorang atau lebih yang tidak mempunyai benturan kepentingan tersebut, untuk mewakili Perseroan dalam menjalankan hal tersebut.

# Board of Commissioners

Dewan Komisaris

The appointment and election of the Board of Commissioners have complied with the provisions of Company's Articles of Association and applicable laws and regulations.

The Board of Commissioners is collectively responsible and has a duty to supervise and provide advice to the Board of Directors in managing the Company, including to ensure that the Company has implemented GCG at all organizational levels or hierarchy. In carrying out its duties, the Board of Commissioners is responsible to the GMS.

Collectively, the Board of Commissioners possesses the expertise to carry out its mandated responsibilities. The Board of Commissioners consists of member(s) who have adequate understanding of business dynamics, the competence to address emerging challenges, and the ability to make independent decisions that drive improvements in the Company's performance. In addition to this, members of the Board of Commissioners effectively review management performance and provide constructive feedback about management performance. All members uphold the highest standards of integrity and have outstanding reputations.

Pengangkatan dan pemilihan Dewan Komisaris telah memenuhi ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab secara kolektif dan bertugas mengawasi dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi dalam pengelolaan Perseroan, termasuk memastikan bahwa Perseroan telah menerapkan GCG pada semua jenjang atau hirarki organisasi. Dalam menjalankan tugasnya, Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab kepada RUPS.

Secara kolektif, Dewan Komisaris memiliki keahlian untuk melaksanakan tanggung jawab yang diamanatkan. Dewan Komisaris terdiri dari anggota yang memiliki pemahaman yang memadai mengenai dinamika bisnis, kompetensi untuk menangani permasalahan yang timbul dalam bisnis, mengatasi tantangan yang muncul, serta kemampuan untuk mengambil keputusan secara mandiri yang mendorong peningkatan kinerja Perseroan. Selain itu, anggota Dewan Komisaris dapat melakukan tinjauan kinerja manajemen secara efektif dan memberikan masukan yang membangun tentang kinerja manajemen. Seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris menjunjung standar integritas tertinggi dan memiliki reputasi yang unggul.

# Duties and Responsibilities

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

The implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners are subject to the provisions stipulated in the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Commissioners has the following duties and responsibilities:

1. Supervise and be responsible for the supervision of management policies and the course of management in general, both regarding the Company and the Company's business, and provide advice to the Board of Directors.
2. Issue the approval for the Company's annual work plan, at the latest before the commencement of the next financial year.
3. Perform tasks specifically assigned to the Board of Commissioners according to the Articles of Association, applicable laws and regulations and/or based on the decision of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
4. Perform its duties, authorities, and responsibilities in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association of the Company and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
5. Examine and study the annual report prepared by the Board of Directors as well as sign the annual report.
6. Comply with the Articles of Association and laws and regulations, and uphold the principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility, and fairness.
7. Represent the Company in the event that the Company has interests that conflict with the personal interest of all members of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest).
8. Establish the Audit Committee, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and other committees in accordance with the requirements stipulated in the laws and regulations in the capital market.
9. Ensure the implementation of all Company policies that have been prepared related to nomination and remuneration processes, performance evaluation, self assessment for members of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, and the policies and criteria of succession/regeneration in the nomination of candidates of the Board of Directors and/or Board of Commissioners.
10. Establish policies and evaluate the Company's performance from a good, stable, growing and sustainable financial aspect.
11. Monitor the implementation of good corporate governance principles.

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris tunduk pada ketentuan yang diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Dewan Komisaris memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab sebagai berikut:

1. Melakukan pengawasan dan bertanggung jawab atas pengawasan terhadap kebijakan pengurusan dan jalannya pengurusan pada umumnya, baik mengenai Perseroan maupun usaha Perseroan, dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi.
2. Memberikan persetujuan atas rencana kerja tahunan Perseroan, selambat-lambatnya sebelum dimulainya tahun buku yang akan datang.
3. Melakukan tugas yang secara khusus diberikan kepada Dewan Komisaris menurut Anggaran Dasar, peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau berdasarkan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
4. Melakukan tugas, wewenang, dan tanggung jawab sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
5. Meneliti dan menelaah laporan tahunan yang dipersiapkan oleh Direksi serta menandatangani laporan tahunan tersebut.
6. Mematuhi Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundangan-undangan, serta wajib melaksanakan prinsip-prinsip profesionalisme, efisiensi, transparansi, kemandirian, akuntabilitas, pertanggungjawaban, serta kewajaran.
7. Mewakili Perseroan dalam hal Perseroan mempunyai kepentingan yang bertentangan dengan kepentingan pribadi seluruh anggota Direksi (benturan kepentingan).
8. Membentuk Komite Audit, Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi serta komite lainnya sesuai dengan persyaratan yang diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang pasar modal.
9. Memastikan dilaksanakannya segala kebijakan Perseroan yang telah disusun terkait dengan nominasi, remunerasi, evaluasi kinerja, penilaian sendiri (self assessment) bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris, dan kebijakan dan kriteria suksesi/regenerasi dalam proses nominasi calon anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris.
10. Menetapkan kebijakan dan melakukan penilaian kinerja Perseroan dari aspek keuangan yang baik, stabil, bertumbuh dan berkelanjutan.
11. Melakukan pemantauan atas penerapan prinsip tata kelola perusahaan yang baik.

# Board of Commissioners Charter

## Piagam Dewan Komisaris

In supervising the Company's management, the Board of Commissioners follows the guidelines from the Board of Commissioners Charter which contains their duties, responsibilities, and authorities.

Dalam mengawasi pengelolaan Perseroan, Dewan Komisaris berpedoman pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris yang memuat tugas, tanggung jawab dan wewenang Dewan Komisaris.

# Performance Assessment of the Board of Directors

## Penilaian atas Kinerja Direksi

The Board of Commissioners highly appreciate the performance of the Board of Directors and all Company personnel for the positive performance achievements amidst various challenges faced. The Board of Commissioners considers that the Board of Directors has given its best efforts and strategies to maintain the stability and continuity of the Company's business.

Dewan Komisaris sangat mengapresiasi kinerja Direksi dan seluruh jajaran Perseroan atas pencapaian kinerja positif yang berhasil dicapai di tengah berbagai tantangan yang muncul. Dewan Komisaris menilai bahwa Direksi telah mengerahkan upaya dan strategi terbaik demi mempertahankan stabilitas dan kelangsungan bisnis Perseroan.

# Assessment of the Performance of the Board of Commissioners

## Penilaian terhadap Kinerja Dewan Komisaris

Referring to the Board of Commissioners Charter, the evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Commissioners is carried out by the Company's shareholders. The Company has also established a Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners, which serves as a guideline for assessing the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners and also as a form of accountability for the performance assessment of the Board of Commissioners of the Company.

The Company's shareholders periodically evaluate the performance of the Board of Commissioners at least once a year. This evaluation assesses the Board of Commissioners' effectiveness in supervising and managing the Company as stated in the prevailing laws and regulations and the Company's Articles of Association.

In addition, based on the Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners, the following are the provisions for the Board of Commissioners performance assessment:

1. Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is performed using a self-assessment method every year collegially.
2. Performance appraisal of each member of the Board of Commissioners is performed by the President Commissioner every year based on the role and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners.
3. Each member of the Board of Commissioners conducts a self-assessment, to which then the results are consolidated for a joint review by all members of the Board of Commissioners in order to determine the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners and the areas that need improvement.
4. The Board of Commissioners prepares the corrective actions, and the President Commissioner ensures the implementation of the corrective actions.

Mengacu pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris, penilaian atas kinerja anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh pemegang saham Perseroan. Perseroan juga telah menetapkan Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris, yang bertindak sebagai pedoman dalam menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris Perseroan.

Pemegang saham Perseroan secara berkala melakukan evaluasi atas kinerja Dewan Komisaris setidaknya satu kali dalam setahun. Evaluasi ini menilai efektivitas Dewan Komisaris dalam melakukan pengawasan dan pengurusan Perseroan sebagaimana yang tercantum dalam peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

Di samping itu, berdasarkan Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris, maka di bawah ini merupakan ketentuan atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris:

1. Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan metode self-assessment setiap tahun secara kolegial.
2. Penilaian kinerja Anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh Komisaris Utama setiap tahun berdasarkan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris.
3. Masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris melakukan self-assessment, kemudian hasilnya dikonsolidasi untuk ditinjau bersama oleh seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris guna menetapkan efektivitas dari Dewan Komisaris beserta area-area yang perlu dilakukan perbaikan.
4. Dewan Komisaris menyusun rencana tindak lanjut perbaikan dan Komisaris Utama memastikan pelaksanaan rencana perbaikan tersebut.

5. Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is conducted by considering several components, which include the structure and composition of the Board of Commissioners, strategy implementation and company management, the effectiveness of the committee, risk management implementation and internal control, and the implementation of Good Corporate Governance.

The Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners also regulates the aspects of the Board of Commissioners' assessment. These aspects of the assessment are among others:

1. Supervise the management of the Company performed by the Board of Directors.
2. Review, examine, and approve the Annual Work Plan of the Company.
3. Carry out special tasks assigned to the member(s) of the Board of Commissioners in accordance with the Articles of Association, prevailing laws and regulations and/or resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
4. Perform his/her duties and responsibilities in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
5. Comply with the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations and be obliged to perform duties based on principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility and fairness, among others to convey the BOC meeting in accordance with the applicable regulations.

5. Penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan mempertimbangkan beberapa komponen, antara lain: struktur dan komposisi Dewan Komisaris, pelaksanaan strategi dan pengelolaan perusahaan, efektivitas pelaksanaan program kerja komite, penerapan manajemen risiko dan pengendalian internal, serta penerapan prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik.

Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris juga mengatur perihal aspek-aspek penilaian Dewan Komisaris. Aspek-aspek penilaian tersebut antara lain:

1. Mengawasi pengurusan Perseroan yang dilaksanakan oleh Direksi.
2. Meninjau, memeriksa, dan menyetujui Rencana Kerja Tahunan Perseroan.
3. Melakukan tugas khusus yang diberikan kepada anggota Dewan Komisaris sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar, hukum dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
4. Melakukan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya sesuai dengan ketentuan-ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
5. Mematuhi Anggaran Dasar serta hukum dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan wajib melaksanakan tugasnya sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip profesionalisme, efisiensi, transparansi, independensi, akuntabilitas, pertanggungjawaban dan kewajaran, antara lain melaksanakan Rapat Dewan Komisaris sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

# Board of Directors

## Direksi

The Board of Directors' responsibility in corporate management is aimed at creating added value and ensuring business continuity. The Board of Directors is in charge and responsible collectively for managing the Company. Each Director performs his/her duties and makes decisions in accordance with the division of duties and authorities. Duties and other matters related to the Board of Directors must be in accordance with the Articles of Association and prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Directors is one of the Company's main organs that holds full responsibility for corporate management in accordance with the Articles of Association. In conducting its duties, the Board of Directors is responsible to the GMS. This responsibility is a manifestation of corporate management accountability in the implementation of GCG principles.

Each member of the Board of Directors may perform their decision-making duty under the segregation of duties and authorities of the Board of Directors. However, the performance of duties of each member of the Board of Directors remains a collective responsibility. The President Director has to coordinate the activities of the Board of Directors.

Tanggung jawab Direksi dalam pengelolaan perusahaan ditujukan untuk menciptakan nilai tambah dan memastikan kelangsungan bisnis. Direksi bertugas dan bertanggung jawab secara kolektif untuk mengelola Perseroan. Setiap Direktur menjalankan tugasnya dan mengambil keputusan sesuai dengan pembagian tugas dan wewenangnya. Tugas, dan hal-hal lain yang berkaitan dengan Direksi harus sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Direksi adalah salah satu organ utama Perseroan yang memegang tanggung jawab penuh atas pengurusan perseroan sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar. Dalam menjalankan tugasnya, Direksi bertanggung jawab kepada RUPS. Tanggung jawab tersebut merupakan wujud akuntabilitas manajemen perusahaan dalam penerapan prinsip-prinsip GCG.

Masing-masing anggota Direksi dapat melaksanakan tugas pengambilan keputusan sesuai dengan pembagian tugas dan wewenangnya, namun pelaksanaan tugas oleh masing-masing anggota Direksi tetap merupakan tanggung jawab bersama. Tugas Direktur Utama adalah mengkoordinasikan seluruh kegiatan Direksi.

# Duties and Authorities of the Board of Directors

## Tugas dan Wewenang Direksi

The implementation of the duties and authorities of the Board of Directors are subject to the provisions stipulated in the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Directors has the duties and responsibilities in accordance with the Articles of Association of the Company as follows:

1. The Board of Directors is in charge of carrying out and being responsible for the management of the Company in all aspects, and for the best interests of the Company in accordance with the purposes and objectives of the Company as stipulated in the Articles of Association. In carrying out the duties and responsibilities of managing the Company, the Board of Directors is supervised by the Board of Commissioners.

2. In carrying out the duties and responsibilities for management, the Board of Directors is required to hold an Annual GMS and other GMS as stipulated in the laws and regulations and the Articles of Association and submit the accountability report on its management to the Shareholders through such GMS.

3. Each member of the Board of Directors must carry out their duties and responsibilities in good faith, full of responsibility and prudence.

4. The Board of Directors is obliged to secure, manage and strive to improve the Company's valuable assets.

5. The Board of Directors has the right to represent the Company inside and outside the Court on all matters and in all events, bind the Company to other parties and other parties to the Company, and carry out all actions regarding decision and ownership, but with the limitation that for certain matters, the Board of Directors must obtain prior approval from the Company's Board of Commissioners, namely:

a. borrowing or lending money on behalf of the Company (excluding withdrawing the Company's money from the banks) which amount is in excess of the limit as determined by the Board of Commissioners from time to time;

b. establishing a business entity or participating in other companies, both in Indonesia or outside Indonesia;

c. binding the Company as guarantor; and

d. purchase or dispose of the Company's assets for a value equal to or above 50% (fifty percent) of the Company's total equity.

However, the involvement of the Board of Commissioners does not negate the responsibility of the Board of Directors for the management of the Company.

6. The Board of Directors must meet the requirements specified in the Capital Market regulations in carrying out actions that constitute material transactions and/or conflict of interests as referred to in the applicable Capital Market regulations.

7. Members of the Board of Directors are not authorized to represent the Company if there is a case in court between the Company and the member of the Board of Directors concerned.

Pelaksanaan tugas dan wewenang Direksi tunduk pada ketentuan yang diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Direksi memiliki tugas dan wewenang Direksi sesuai Anggaran Dasar Perseroan yakni sebagai berikut:

1. Direksi bertugas menjalankan dan bertanggung jawab atas pengurusan Perseroan di segala aspek, dan untuk kepentingan terbaik Perseroan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan yang ditetapkan dalam Anggaran Dasar. Dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawab atas pengurusan Perseroan, Direksi diawasi oleh Dewan Komisaris.

2. Direksi wajib menyelenggarakan RUPS Tahunan dan RUPS lainnya sebagaimana diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan dan Anggaran Dasar, dan menyampaikan laporan pertanggungjawaban atas pengurusannya kepada para Pemegang Saham melalui RUPS tersebut.

3. Setiap anggota Direksi wajib melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehati-hatian.

4. Direksi wajib mengamankan, mengelola, dan berupaya meningkatkan aset-aset berharga Perseroan.

5. Direksi berhak mewakili Perseroan di dalam dan di luar Pengadilan tentang segala hal dan dalam segala kejadian, mengikat Perseroan dengan pihak lain dan pihak lain dengan Perseroan, serta menjalankan segala tindakan baik yang mengenai kepengurusan maupun kepemilikan, akan tetapi dengan pembatasan bahwa untuk hal-hal tertentu, Direksi harus memperoleh persetujuan terlebih dahulu dari Dewan Komisaris Perseroan, yakni:

a. meminjam atau meminjamkan uang atas nama Perseroan (tidak termasuk pengambilan uang Perseroan di bank-bank) yang jumlahnya melebihi batasan sebagaimana ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris dari waktu ke waktu;

b. mendirikan suatu usaha atau turut serta pada perusahaan lain baik di dalam maupun di luar negeri;

c. mengikat Perseroan sebagai penjamin; dan

d. membeli atau melepaskan aset Perseroan untuk nilai setara atau di atas 50% (lima puluh persen) dari total ekuitas Perseroan.

Namun demikian, keterlibatan Dewan Komisaris tersebut tidak meniadakan tanggung jawab Direksi atas pelaksanaan kepengurusan Perseroan.

6. Direksi harus memenuhi persyaratan yang ditentukan dalam peraturan Pasar Modal dalam melaksanakan tindakan yang merupakan transaksi material dan/atau benturan kepentingan yang dimaksud dalam peraturan Pasar Modal yang berlaku.

7. Anggota Direksi tidak berwenang mewakili Perseroan apabila terdapat perkara di pengadilan antara Perseroan dengan anggota Direksi yang bersangkutan.

8. If something happens where the interests of the Company conflict with the personal interests of a member of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest), the Company will be represented by another member of the Board of Directors who does not have a conflict of interest.

In the event that the Company has interests that conflict with personal interests of all members of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest), then the Company will be represented by the Board of Commissioners.

When the Company suffers a loss, each member of the Board of Directors is jointly and severally responsible for the Company's losses caused by the mistakes or negligence of members of the Board of Directors in carrying out their duties. However, member(s) of the Board of Directors are not required to fulfill these responsibilities if he/she can prove the following:

1. The loss was not due to his/her fault or negligence;
2. He/she has conducted management in good faith, full of responsibility and prudence for the benefit of the Company and in accordance with the aims and objectives of the Company;
3. He/she has no conflict of interest, either directly or indirectly, for the management actions that resulted in the loss; and
4. He/she has taken action to prevent the loss or the continuation of the loss.

Further, members of the Board of Directors shall, in performing their duties and responsibilities, be required to comply with the Code of Conducts of the Company and are prohibited from taking personal advantages, both directly and indirectly, from the Company's activities other than salaries and other benefits which they are legally entitled to, including the retirement benefits they receive as members of Board of Directors in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations. The President Director is obliged to ensure compliance of all members of the Board of Directors with the Code of Conduct of the Company, including settling any conflicts that may arise.

8. Apabila terjadi sesuatu hal dimana kepentingan Perseroan bertentangan dengan kepentingan pribadi salah satu anggota Direksi (benturan kepentingan), Perseroan akan diwakili oleh anggota Direksi lainnya yang tidak mempunyai benturan kepentingan.

Dalam hal Perseroan mempunyai kepentingan yang bertentangan dengan kepentingan pribadi seluruh anggota Direksi (benturan kepentingan), merawati dalam hal tersebut Perseroan akan diwakili oleh Dewan Komisaris.

Ketika Perseroan mengalami kerugian, setiap anggota Direksi bertanggung jawab secara tanggung renteng atas kerugian Perseroan yang disebabkan oleh kesalahan atau kelalaian anggota Direksi dalam menjalankan tugasnya. Namun, anggota Direksi tidak perlu untuk memenuhi tanggung jawab tersebut apabila ia dapat membuktikan hal-hal sebagai berikut:

1. Kerugian tersebut bukan karena kesalahan atau kelalaiannya;
2. Ia telah melakukan pengurusan dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehati-hatian untuk kepentingan Perseroan dan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan;
3. Ia tidak mempunyai benturan kepentingan baik langsung maupun tidak langsung atas tindakan pengurusan yang mengakibatkan kerugian tersebut; dan
4. Ia telah mengambil tindakan untuk mencegah timbulnya kerugian atau berlanjutnya kerugian tersebut.

Lebih lanjut, anggota Direksi, dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya, wajib mematuhi Kode Etik Perseroan dan dilarang mengambil keuntungan pribadi baik langsung maupun tidak langsung dari kegiatan Perseroan selain gaji dan tunjangan lain yang menjadi haknya secara sah, termasuk tunjangan pensiun yang diterimanya sebagai anggota Direksi sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Presiden Direktur wajib memastikan kepatuhan seluruh anggota Direksi terhadap Kode Etik Perseroan, termasuk menyelesaikan setiap konflik yang mungkin timbul.

# Division of Duties among the Board of Directors

## Pembagian Tugas di antara Direksi

The distribution of duties and authorities for each member of the Board of Directors is determined by the GMS. In the event that the GMS does not stipulate such matter, the division of duties and authorities of members of the Board of Directors will be determined based on the decision of the Board of Directors.

In order to support the effective implementation of the Board of Directors' duties, duties have been allocated among the members of the Board of Directors. The assignments are based on the expertise and experience of each member, with the aim of supporting an accurate and quick decision-making process.

The President Director has the right and authority to act on behalf of the Board of Directors and represent the Company. In the event that the President Director is absent or unable to attend due to any reason, which does not need to be proven to a third party, then other members of the Board of Directors have the right and authority to act for and on behalf of the Board of Directors and represent them.

Pembagian tugas dan wewenang setiap anggota Direksi ditetapkan oleh RUPS. Dalam hal RUPS tidak menetapkan, maka pembagian tugas dan wewenang anggota Direksi akan ditetapkan berdasarkan keputusan Direksi.

Untuk mendukung efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas Direksi, telah dialokasikan tugas di antara anggota Direksi. Penugasan didasarkan pada keahlian dan pengalaman masing-masing anggota, dengan tujuan untuk mendukung proses pengambilan keputusan yang akurat dan cepat.

Presiden Direktur berhak dan berwenang bertindak atas nama Direksi serta mewakili Perseroan. Dalam hal Presiden Direktur tidak hadir atau berhalangan untuk hadir karena sebab apapun juga, hal mana tidak perlu dibuktikan kepada pihak ketiga, maka anggota Direksi lainnya berhak dan berwenang bertindak untuk dan atas nama Direksi serta mewakili.

# Board of Directors Charter

## Piagam Direksi

In managing the Company, the Board of Directors follows the guidelines from the Board of Directors Charter as inaugurated on June 9, 2015, which contains the work guidelines and rules, authorities, duties, responsibilities, obligations, division of tasks, meetings, provisions on conflicts of interest, share ownership, mechanism arrangements and division of labor between members of the Board of Directors that are not regulated in the Company's Articles of Association or applicable laws and regulations. With the existence of the Board of Directors Charter, it is hoped that the performance of the Board of Directors will be more focused and in synergy with one another.

The Board of Directors Charter has been formulated based on the prevailing rules and regulations in Indonesia and is evaluated periodically to ensure its suitability with the development of the Company and the business environment.

Dalam mengelola Perseroan, Direksi berpedoman pada Piagam Direksi yang diresmikan pada tanggal 9 Juni 2015, yang memuat pedoman dan tata tertib kerja, wewenang, tugas, tanggung jawab, kewajiban, pembagian tugas, rapat, ketentuan benturan kepentingan, kepemilikan saham, pengaturan mekanisme dan pembagian kerja antar para anggota Direksi yang tidak diatur di dalam Anggaran Dasar Perseroan maupun ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Dengan adanya Piagam Direksi, diharapkan kinerja Direksi lebih terarah dan bersinergi satu sama lain.

Piagam Direksi tersebut telah diformulasikan berdasarkan ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku di Indonesia, serta dievaluasi secara periodik untuk memastikan kesesuaiannya dengan perkembangan Perseroan dan lingkungan usaha.

# Assessment of the Performance of the Board of Directors

## Penilaian terhadap Kinerja Direksi

The evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Directors is carried out by the Board of Commissioners and shareholders of the Company with reference to the Board of Directors Charter. The Company also has a Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Directors, which serves as a guideline for assessing the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Directors and also as a form of accountability for the performance assessment of the Board of Directors of the Company.

The Board of Directors Charter contains an explanation of the method for evaluating the performance of members of the Board of Directors, which includes the following:

1. The Board of Commissioners will determine the Key Performance Indicators (KPI);
2. The Board of Commissioners will evaluate the performance achievements of the members of the Board of Directors which will then be submitted to the shareholders at the GMS;
3. The performance evaluation of the members of the Board of Directors will be carried out based on the following KPIs:
- Achievement of the Board of Directors' performance (collectively) by looking at the Company's achievements based on the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, and/or other criteria determined by the Board of Commissioners.
- Achievement of the performance of the Board of Directors (individually) in achieving the Company's performance as stated in the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, Management Contract, and or other criteria determined in the Board of Commissioners meeting.
- Implementation of GCG principles, both individually and collectively.

Penilaian atas kinerja anggota Direksi dilakukan oleh Dewan Komisaris dan pemegang saham Perseroan dengan mengacu pada Piagam Direksi. Perseroan juga telah memiliki Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Direksi, yang mana kebijakan ini disusun sebagai pedoman untuk menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Direksi dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Direksi Perseroan.

Piagam Direksi memuat penjelasan mengenai metode evaluasi/penilaian kinerja atas anggota Direksi, yang mana di antaranya adalah sebagai berikut:

1. Dewan Komisaris akan menetapkan Indikator Kinerja Utama/ Key Performance Indicator (KPI);
2. Dewan Komisaris akan melakukan evaluasi atas pencapaian kinerja dari anggota Direksi yang mana selanjutnya akan disampaikan pada pemegang saham dalam RUPS;
3. Evaluasi kinerja anggota Direksi tersebut akan dilakukan berdasarkan KPI sebagai berikut:
- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara bersama-sama) dengan melihat pencapaian Perseroan berdasarkan Rencana Bisnis dan Rencana Operasional Tahunan, dan/atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris.
- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara individu) dalam mencapai kinerja Perseroan sebagaimana tercantum dalam Rencana Bisnis dan Rencana Operasional Tahunan, Kontrak Manajemen, dan atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan dalam rapat Dewan Komisaris.
- Implementasi prinsip-prinsip GCG, baik secara individu maupun kolektif.

In addition, the Board of Directors performance appraisal is also stipulated in the Board of Directors Performance Assessment Policy, namely:

1. All members of the Board of Directors have performance goals based on the duties and responsibilities of each member.
2. Performance appraisal of the Board of Directors is conducted every year by the President Director.
3. Performance appraisal results of the Board of Directors are reported to the Board of Commissioners through the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

The Board of Directors' Performance Assessment Policy also regulates the aspects of the Board of Directors' assessment. These aspects include:

1. Lead, manage, and control the Company in accordance with the purpose of the Company.
2. Make some efforts to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the Company.
3. Prepare an annual work plan containing the annual budget of the Company and submit the plan to the Board of Commissioner to obtain approval before the beginning of the following fiscal year.
4. Perform his/her duties and responsibilities pursuant to the provisions of the Articles of Association and the resolutions of the GMS.
5. Comply with the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations, and be obliged to perform duties based on principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility and fairness, i.e., to convey the meeting of the Board of Directors in accordance with the applicable regulations.

# Audit Committee

## Komite Audit

The Company formed the Audit Committee with the aim of assisting the Board of Commissioners in carrying out oversight functions. The Audit Committee is tasked to ensure that the Company is managed with sound management in accordance with GCG principles and applicable laws and regulations. In addition, the Audit Committee is required to provide advice to the Board of Commissioners regarding the implementation of internal control and company audits, make a written report on each special assignment mandated by the Board of Commissioners, and make reports on the implementation of each audit activity carried out by the Audit Committee in the Company and its subsidiaries, including the level of achievement of the performance of the Audit Committee. The activities and performance of the Audit Committee must be disclosed in the Company's Annual Report.

The Company's Audit Committee is appointed based on the decision of the Board of Commissioners and responsible to the Board of Commissioners in assisting and carrying out the duties and functions of the Board of Commissioners.

Perseroan membentuk Komite Audit dengan tujuan untuk membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam melaksanakan fungsi pengawasan. Komite Audit bertugas untuk memastikan Perseroan dikelola dengan manajemen yang sehat sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip GCG dan peraturan perundangan yang berlaku. Selain itu, Komite Audit wajib memberikan nasihat kepada Dewan Komisaris sehubungan dengan pelaksanaan pengendalian internal dan audit perusahaan, membuat laporan secara tertulis atas setiap penugasan khusus yang diamanatkan oleh Dewan Komisaris, serta membuat laporan pelaksanaan atas setiap kegiatan audit yang dilakukan oleh Komite Audit pada Perseroan dan anak perusahaannya, termasuk juga tingkat pencapaian kinerja Komite Audit. Kegiatan dan kinerja Komite Audit wajib diungkapkan dalam Laporan Tahunan Perseroan.

Komite Audit Perseroan diangkat berdasarkan keputusan Dewan Komisaris dan bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris dalam membantu dan melaksanakan tugas dan fungsi Dewan Komisaris.

# Duties and Responsibilities

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee reports directly to the Board of Commissioners.

The scope of duties and responsibilities of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee are as follows:

1. In relation to the Nomination function:

a. Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding:

(1) Composition of positions of members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;
(2) Policies and criteria required in the nomination process; and
(3) Performance evaluation policy for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;

b. Assist the Board of Commissioners in assessing the performance of members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners based on benchmarks that have been prepared as evaluation materials;
c. Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding capability development programs for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners; and
d. Provide proposals of candidates who meet the requirements as members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners, to the Board of Commissioners to be submitted further to the GMS.

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Dewan Komisaris.

Lingkup tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi adalah sebagai berikut:

1. Terkait dengan fungsi Nominasi:

a. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:

(1) Komposisi jabatan anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
(2) Kebijakan dan kriteria yang dibutuhkan dalam proses nominasi; dan
(3) Kebijakan evaluasi kinerja bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;

b. Membantu Dewan Komisaris melakukan penilaian kinerja anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris berdasarkan tolok ukur yang telah disusun sebagai bahan evaluasi;
c. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai program pengembangan kemampuan anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris; dan
d. Memberikan usulan calon yang memenuhi syarat sebagai anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris, kepada Dewan Komisaris untuk disampaikan lebih lanjut kepada RUPS.

2. In relation to the Remuneration function:
a. Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding:
(1) Remuneration structure;
(2) Remuneration policy; and
(3) Remuneration amount.
b. Assist the Board of Commissioners in assessing performance according to the remuneration received by each member of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners.

3. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee must act independently in carrying out its duties.

2. Terkait dengan fungsi Remunerasi:
a. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:
(1) Struktur remunerasi;
(2) Kebijakan atas remunerasi; dan
(3) Besaran atas remunerasi.
b. Membantu Dewan Komisaris melakukan penilaian kinerja dengan kesesuaian remunerasi yang diterima masing-masing anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris.

3. Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi wajib bertindak independen dalam melaksanakan tugasnya.

# Internal Audit Unit

## Unit Audit Internal

The Internal Audit Unit was formed based on the Decree of the Board of Directors Number 05/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 regarding the Establishment of the Company's Internal Audit Unit dated June 19, 2020.

The Internal Audit Unit is a supporting division to the Board of Directors that is responsible for monitoring and evaluating internal controls, as well as providing independent and objective assurance and consultations to create added value and improve operational performance.

The Internal Audit Unit is responsible to the President Director and acts independently in carrying out its duties and responsibilities. The Internal Audit Unit has unrestricted access to all functions and records within the Company to fully carry out its mandate.

Mr. Devy Heriyanto was appointed as the Head of the Company's Internal Audit Unit as of February 21, 2025, replacing Mr. Patrick Lian Abuan Go, based on the Company's Board of Directors Decree Number 01/SK-DIR/SOHO/II/2025.

The complete biography of the Head of Internal Audit Unit can be seen in the Company Profile section.

Unit Audit Internal dibentuk berdasarkan Keputusan Direksi Perseroan Nomor 05/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 tentang Pembentukan Unit Audit Internal Perseroan tertanggal 19 Juni 2020.

Unit Audit Internal merupakan divisi pendukung dari Direksi yang bertanggung jawab untuk melaksanakan pemantauan dan evaluasi atas pengendalian internal, serta memberikan keyakinan dan konsultasi yang bersifat independen dan objektif guna meningkatkan nilai tambah dan kinerja operasional.

Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden Direktur dan bertindak secara independen dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Unit Audit Internal memiliki akses tidak terbatas ke semua fungsi dan catatan di dalam Perseroan, agar dapat menjalankan amanatnya secara penuh.

Tuan Devy Heriyanto ditunjuk sebagai Kepala Unit Audit Internal Perseroan per 21 Februari 2025 menggantikan Tuan Patrick Lian Abuan Go, berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Direksi Perseroan Nomor 01/SK-DIR/SOHO/II/2025.

## Duties and Responsibilities

### Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

The Internal Audit Unit reports directly to the President Director, the Board of Directors, the Board of Commissioners and the Audit Committee. The Internal Audit Unit is an independent unit within the Company.

The scope of duties and responsibilities of the Internal Audit Unit are as follows:

a. Prepare and implement annual Internal Audit plans;
b. Test and evaluate the implementation of internal control and management system in accordance with Company policy;
c. Examine and assess the efficiency and effectiveness of finance, accounting, operations, human resources, marketing, information technology and other activities;

Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Presiden Direktur, Direksi, Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit. Unit Audit Internal adalah unit yang bersifat independen di dalam Perseroan.

Ruang Lingkup tugas dan tanggung jawab Unit Audit Internal adalah sebagai berikut:

a. Menyusun dan melaksanakan rencana Audit Internal tahunan;

f. Monitor, analyze and report on the implementation of the suggested improvements;
g. Liaise with the Audit Committee;

j. Conduct special audit, if needed.

d. Memberikan saran perbaikan dan informasi yang objektif tentang kegiatan yang diperiksa pada semua tingkat manajemen;
e. Membuat laporan hasil audit dan menyampaikan laporan tersebut kepada Presiden Direktur, Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit;

g. Bekerja sama dengan Komite Audit;
h. Menyusun program untuk mengevaluasi mutu kegiatan audit internal yang dilakukannya;
i. Membantu dalam penyelidikan dugaan penipuan yang signifikan; dan

### Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

The Corporate Secretary reports directly to the Board of Directors.

2. Provide input to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners of the Company to comply with the provisions of laws and regulations in the Capital Market sector;

c. organizing and documenting the General Meeting of Shareholders;
d. organizing and documenting the meetings of the Board of Directors and/or the Board of Commissioners; and
e. implement the Company orientation program for the Board of Directors and/or the Board of Commissioners.
4. Act as a liaison or contact person between the Company and the shareholders of the Company, the Financial Services Authority, and other stakeholders; and
5. Provide access to the public for all relevant information regarding the current condition of the Company.

# Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption Policy

Kebijakan Anti Suap dan Anti Korupsi

The Company has implemented an Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption Policy since January 2014 to comply with the Corruption Eradication Law, and in accordance with the Indonesian Corporate Governance General Guidelines, the Company periodically updates this policy with revisions made in 2017, 2020, and the most recent update in May 2023.

The Company established the Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption Policy as part of its good corporate governance initiatives, with the following objectives:

1. Create awareness to prevent potential financial and non-financial losses, including acts that can damage the Company reputation;
2. Establish a policy and process that will protect the whistleblower from retaliation from internal or external parties who were reported;
3. Avoid or reduce potential Company losses that will be incurred due to violations, by implementing early detection; and
4. Improve the Company's reputation.

This policy supplements the Company's Code of Business Ethics and Conduct by providing specific guidance about receiving and provisioning items of value that may violate the above regulations, resulting in sanctions and reputational damage to the Company.

In cases of gratification, under certain conditions, including situations where it is impossible/difficult or impractical to refuse a gift/reward, the employee may be allowed to receive such gift/reward from external parties upon the condition that such employee is obliged to report such gift/reward provisioning to the relevant parties and the Compliance Division for further review and assessment.

The Company has a whistleblowing system to support reports about possible violations of the above policy which are handled with full anonymity and protection from retaliation.

Throughout the Year 2024, there were some instances of reported receipt of gifts by Company employees, which were consulted to and assessed by our compliance officer. There was no reported instance that violated the above policy.

Perseroan telah memiliki kebijakan mengenai Anti-Suap (Anti-Bribery) dan Anti-Korupsi (Anti-Corruption) sejak Januari 2014, yang mana dalam rangka untuk mematuhi Undang-Undang Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Korupsi, dan sesuai dengan Pedoman Umum Governansi Koporat Indonesia, Perseroan terus melakukan pengkinian dari waktu ke waktu sehingga kebijakan tersebut telah mengalami beberapa perubahan pada tahun 2017, 2020, hingga perubahan terakhir pada Mei 2023.

Perseroan menetapkan kebijakan anti-suap dan anti-korupsi tersebut sebagai bagian dari inisiatif tata kelola perusahaan yang baik, dengan tujuan sebagai berikut:

1. Menciptakan kesadaran untuk mencegah potensi kerugian finansial maupun non-finansial, termasuk hal-hal yang dapat merusak reputasi Perseroan;
2. Membangun suatu kebijakan dan proses yang akan melindungi pelapor dari upaya pembalasan dari pihak-pihak internal maupun eksternal yang dilaporkan;
3. Menghindari atau mengurangi potensi kerugian Perseroan yang akan timbul karena adanya pelanggaran, dengan melakukan deteksi dini; dan
4. Meningkatkan reputasi Perseroan.

# Handling of Reported Violations
## Penanganan atas Pelanggaran Yang Dilaporkan

Reported cases are received by the compliance officer. The informations are analyzed and investigated for evidence gathering by selected members of the Internal Audit Unit (if necessary).

If necessary, the case will be deliberated by the Ethics Committee. The whistleblower and any relevant party will be informed about the outcome and the action taken.

The Board of Directors and/or the Board of Commissioners are updated on the summary of reports.

Kasus yang dilaporkan diterima oleh petugas kepatuhan. Informasi dianalisis dan diselidiki untuk pengumpulan bukti oleh anggota terpilih dari Unit Internal Audit (jika diperlukan).

Jika perlu, kasus tersebut akan dibahas oleh Komite Etik. Pelapor dan pihak terkait akan diberitahu tentang hasil dan tindakan yang diambil.

Direksi dan/atau Dewan Komisaris akan mendapatkan informasi terbaru tentang ringkasan laporan.

In addition, Risk Management also aims to ensure that management and all employees have the same perception and understanding of the concept of risk management and raise awareness of the importance of risk management.

Selain itu, Manajemen Risiko tersebut juga bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa manajemen dan seluruh pegawai memiliki persepsi serta pemahaman yang sama mengenai konsep manajemen risiko dan menumbuhkan kesadaran mengenai pentingnya manajemen risiko.

The responsibility for carrying out risk assessments lies with each work unit in the Company (Department/Division). The assessment is documented in a Risk Assessment Form which serves as a risk register for such working unit. ## Types of Risk and Management Methods
### Jenis Risiko dan Cara Pengelolaannya

The following are the types of risks used by the Company as a benchmark for conducting risk analysis, including:

a. **Operational Risk:**

Risks that arise due to insufficient and/or failure of internal processes, human error, system failure, or external problems affecting business activities such as force majeure, natural disasters, fires and others.

b. **Compliance Risk:**

Risks caused due to the Company not complying with or not implementing statutory regulations and other applicable provisions.

c. **Strategic Risk:**

Risks that arise due to improper strategic determination and implementation, inappropriate decision making, or the Company's lack of responsiveness to external changes.

d. **Reputation Risk:**

Risks that arise due to negative publicity on operational activities or negative perceptions of the Company.

Risk assessments are conducted to analyze and estimate the probability and the severity level of the identified risk. The result of the assessment will help determine which risks should be prioritized for further action. Risk responses are continuously monitored by the relevant work unit, and if the relevant work unit is not able to reduce the identified risks to a level within the Company's risk appetite, additional measures shall be taken.

The risk scores which are mandatory to be mitigated are medium and high. Risk mitigation measures include identifying options for dealing with risks, assessing those options, preparing a risk treatment plan, implementing the risk treatment plan and carrying out subsequent monitoring.

Tanggung jawab pelaksanaan penilaian risiko berada pada masing-masing unit kerja Perseroan (Departemen/Divisi). Penilaian tersebut didokumentasikan dalam Risk Assessment Form yang akan berfungsi sebagai daftar risiko untuk unit kerja tersebut. Penilaian risiko dilakukan secara berkelanjutan oleh unit kerja yang kemudian diuji serta ditelaah oleh Divisi Internal Audit minimal setiap tahun.

Daftar dan profil risiko Perseroan dilaporkan dan ditinjau oleh manajemen Perseroan setiap tahun atau dalam hal terjadinya perubahan signifikan.

Berikut merupakan jenis-jenis risiko yang digunakan oleh Perseroan sebagai tolak ukur untuk melakukan analisa resiko, antara lain:

a. **Risiko Operasional:**

Risiko yang ditimbulkan karena ketidakcukupan dan/atau kegagalan proses internal, kesalahan manusia, kegagalan sistem, atau adanya masalah eksternal yang mempengaruhi kegiatan usaha seperti force majeure, bencana alam, kebakaran dan lain-lain.

b. **Risiko Kepatuhan:**

Risiko yang disebabkan karena Perseroan tidak mematuhi atau tidak melaksanakan regulasi perundang-undangan dan ketentuan lain yang berlaku.

c. **Risiko Strategis:**

Risiko yang timbul karena penetapan dan pelaksanaan strategis yang tidak tepat, pengambilan keputusan yang tidak tepat, atau kurang responsifnya Perseroan terhadap perubahan eksternal.

d. **Risiko Reputasi:**

Risiko yang timbul karena publikasi negatif terhadap kegiatan operasional atau persepsi negatif terhadap Perseroan.

Penilaian risiko dilakukan untuk menganalisa dan memperkirakan probabilitas dan tingkat keparahan risiko yang teridentifikasi. Hasil penilaian risiko akan membantu menentukan risiko apa saja yang harus diprioritaskan untuk ditindaklanjuti. Tanggapan terhadap risiko dipantau secara terus menerus oleh unit kerja terkait, dan apabila unit kerja tersebut tidak mampu mengurangi risiko yang teridentifikasi ke tingkat yang sesuai dengan toleransi risiko Perusahaan, maka langkah-langkah tambahan perlu diambil.

Nilai risiko yang wajib dilakukan mitigasi adalah sedang dan tinggi. Langkah mitigasi risiko meliputi pengidentifikasi opsi untuk menangani risiko, menilai opsi tersebut, menyiapkan rencana perlakuan risiko, mengimplementasikan rencana perlakuan risiko dan melakukan pemantauan selanjutnya.

## Akuntan Publik

Public Accountant is an external party supporting the Company in evaluating or auditing the Annual Report in accordance with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards. Referring to the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 9 of 2023 on the Use of Public Accountant Services and Public Accounting Firms in Financial Services Activities, the appointment of a Public Accountant is expected to help Company provide accountable, independent, and fair information and data to the shareholders, regulator, as well as other stakeholders.

Akuntan Publik merupakan organ eksternal yang membantu Perseroan dalam melakukan pemeriksaan atau mengaudit Laporan Keuangan agar sesuai dengan Standar Akuntasi Keuangan yang berlaku di Indonesia. Mengacu pada Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 9 Tahun 2023 tentang Penggunaan Jasa Akuntan Publik dan Kantor Akuntan Publik dalam Kegiatan Jasa Keuangan, maka penunjukan Akuntan Publik ini diharapkan dapat mendorong Perseroan untuk memberikan informasi dan data yang akuntabel, independen, dan wajar kepada pemegang saham, regulator, serta pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

## External Audit Procedures and Audit Standards

### Prosedur Audit Eksternal dan Standar Audit

The audit of the Company's Financial Statement is implemented in accordance with public accountant's professional standards which covers all audit procedures regarded compatible with the Company's condition. The audit process encompasses testing, verifying, and evaluating the Financial Statements, as well as assessing the compliance of its contents with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards ("PSAK").

The appointment of a Public Accounting Firm ("KAP") is carried out by taking into account the aspects of independency in terms of personnel, processes and audit results so that the Company's Financial Statements fulfil the principles of transparency and accountability.

As a part of the audit process, the KAP representatives conducted a question-and-answer session regarding the management's statements presented in the Financial Statement. If any mistakes are found in the Financial Statement, the KAP must convey it to the management of the Company. The management is also responsible for approving the KAP's audit worksheets.

Audit Laporan Keuangan Perseroan dilakukan sesuai standar profesional akuntan publik, yang mencakup seluruh prosedur audit yang dianggap sesuai dengan keadaan perusahaan. Audit yang dilakukan meliputi pengujian, pemeriksaan, dan evaluasi terhadap Laporan Keuangan, serta penilaian terhadap kesesuaian isi Laporan Keuangan dengan Standar Akuntansi Keuangan Indonesia ("PSAK").

Penunjukan Kantor Akuntan Publik ("KAP") dilaksanakan dengan memperhatikan aspek independensi dari sisi personil, proses, dan hasil audit sehingga Laporan Keuangan Perseroan memenuhi prinsip transparansi dan akuntabilitas.

Sebagai bagian dari proses audit, perwakilan KAP melakukan sesi tanya jawab mengenai pernyataan manajemen yang disampaikan dalam Laporan Keuangan. Jika terdapat kekeliruan di dalam laporan tersebut, maka KAP wajib menyampaikannya kepada manajemen Perseroan. Manajemen juga bertanggung jawab untuk menyetujui kertas kerja pemeriksa KAP terhadap Perseroan.

# The Policy relating to Protection of Creditor's Rights

Kebijakan tentang Pemenuhan Hak-Hak Kreditur

This policy is related to the fulfillment of creditor's right with the objectives to uphold the fulfillment of creditor's right and preserve the trust given by the creditor to the Company.

Kebijakan ini terkait pemenuhan hak-hak kreditur yang bertujuan untuk menjunjung tinggi pemenuhan hak-hak kreditur dan menjaga kepercayaan yang diberikan kreditur kepada Perseroan.

## The Main Principle of Policy

Prinsip Utama Kebijakan

As a form of the Company's commitment to implementing GCG principles, the Company continually strives to hold the interest of its creditors in high regards, recognizing their role in improving the Company's working capital capabilities as well as a source of funding for medium-term and long-term investments. By maintaining their trust, the Company ensures sustainable growth and long-term business prospects.

The Company is committed to establishing mutually beneficial relationships with its creditors. The Company fully implements the agreements that have been agreed and signed as long as the agreements do not conflict with applicable laws and regulations.

Therefore, the Company has established the Policy on the Fulfillment of Creditor's Rights which aims to maintain the fulfillment of creditor's rights and maintain the trust given by the creditors to the Company.

Sebagai wujud komitmen Perseroan dalam menerapkan prinsip-prinsip GCG, Perseroan senantiasa berupaya untuk menjunjung tinggi kepentingan para kreditur, mengakui peran mereka dalam mendukung modal kerja Perseroan maupun sebagai sumber pendanaan untuk keperluan investasi jangka menengah dan panjang. Dengan menjaga kepercayaan mereka, Perseroan memastikan pertumbuhan berkelanjutan dan prospek usaha jangka panjang.

Perseroan berkomitmen untuk menjalin hubungan yang saling bermanfaat dengan para kreditur. Perseroan sepenuhnya melaksanakan perjanjian yang telah disepakati dan ditandatangani sepanjang perjanjian tersebut tidak bertentangan dengan peraturan dan perundangan yang berlaku.

Oleh karenanya Perseroan telah menyusun Kebijakan tentang Pemenuhan Hak-Hak Kreditur yang bertujuan untuk menjaga terpenuhinya hak-hak kreditur dan menjaga kepercayaan yang diberikan para kreditur terhadap Perseroan.

## The principles of the Policy on Fulfillment of Creditor's Rights carried out by the Company are as follows:

Prinsip-prinsip Kebijakan Pemenuhan Hak-hak Kreditur yang dilakukan oleh Perseroan adalah sebagai berikut:

1. The Company considers and measures its ability internally to fulfill creditors' rights before the Company decides on taking any loans. This is conducted to ensure the fulfillment of creditors' rights and in order to maintain creditors' trust in the Company;
2. The Company elects a creditor based on aspects of credibility that can be accounted for;
3. The Company provides information or documents related to the loan and/or agreement transparently, accurately and in a timely manner as agreed in the respective loan agreement with the creditor;

1. Perseroan mempertimbangkan dan mengukur kemampuannya secara internal dalam memenuhi hak-hak kreditur sebelum Perseroan memutuskan untuk mengambil pinjaman apapun. Hal ini dilakukan untuk menjaga terpenuhinya hak-hak kreditur dan dalam rangka menjaga kepercayaan kreditur terhadap Perseroan;
2. Perseroan melakukan pemilihan kreditur berdasarkan aspek kredibilitas yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan;
3. Perseroan memberikan informasi atau dokumen-dokumen terkait pinjaman dan/atau kesepakatan secara transparan, akurat dan tepat waktu sebagaimana disepakati dalam masing-masing perjanjian pinjaman dengan kreditur;
