## PT. SOHO INDUSTRI PHARMASI ("SIP")

### 1. PT. Mitra Semeru Indonesia ("Mitra Semeru")

**Case Status**
**Status Perkara**

SIP has past due receiveables owed by Mitra Semeru for the pharmaceutical products supplied by SIP to Mitra Semeru. Mitra Semeru has paid the principal of the receivables to SIP but has not yet settled the default interest on the receivables.

SIP mempunyai piutang yang telah jatuh tempo dan terutang kepada Mitra Semeru atas produk farmasi yang dipasok oleh SIP kepada Mitra Semeru. Mitra Semeru telah melunasi pokok piutang yang dimiliki kepada SIP namun belum membayarkan bunga moratoir atas piutang tersebut.

**Risks Faced by the Company and the Impact on the Company**
**Risiko yang Dihadapi dan Pengaruhnya terhadap Perseroan**

SIP is at risk of not getting a full refund of moratoir interest amounting to IDR 6,846,017,853 (six billion eight hundred forty six million seventeen thousand eight hundred and fifty three Rupiah).

SIP berisiko tidak akan memperoleh bunga moratoir yang jumlahnya sebesar Rp 6.846.017.853,- (enam miliar delapan ratus empat puluh enam juta tujuh belas ribu delapan ratus lima puluh tiga Rupiah).

**Follow-up**
**Tindak Lanjut**

SIP has submitted a lawsuit to the East Jakarta District Court and the case is still in progress.

SIP telah mengajukan gugatan ke Pengadilan Negeri Jakarta Timur dan masih dalam proses.

## PT. Parit Padang Global ("PPG")

### 1. PT. Asuransi Himalaya Pelindung ("Asuransi Himalaya")

**Case Status**
**Status Perkara**

PPG is a policyholder of Himalaya Insurance and has submitted a claim for product damages to Himalaya Insurance covering the period from August 1, 2016 to January 22, 2018. However, to date, PPG has not received any payment for the claim. Through its attorney, PPG has filed a complaint with the Financial Services Authority regarding this matter. According to the Complaint Response Letter from the OJK dated July 19, 2021 Himalaya Insurance's operational license has been revoked and the company is set to be dissolved. A liquidation team has been appointed to handle the settlement of the claims submitted by PPG.

PPG merupakan pemegang polis Asuransi Himalaya dan telah mengajukan klaim atas kerusakan produk kepada Asuransi Himalaya selama periode 1 Agustus 2016 sampai 22 Januari 2018. Namun, PPG sampai saat ini belum menerima pembayaran terhadap klaim-klaim tersebut. Melalui kuasa hukumnya, PPG telah melakukan pengaduan kepada OJK terkait hal tersebut. Berdasarkan Surat Tanggapan Pengaduan dari OJK tertanggal 19 Juli 2021, dinyatakan bahwa izin operasional Asuransi Himalaya telah dicabut dan Asuransi Himalaya telah ditetapkan untuk dibubarkan. Tim likuidasi atas aset Asuransi Himalaya telah ditunjuk oleh OJK untuk menangani pembayaran tagihan yang telah diajukan oleh PPG.

Risks Faced by the Company and the Impact on the Company Risiko yang Dihadapi dan Pengaruhnya terhadap Perseroan

PPG is at risk of not getting a full refund of its claims amounting to IDR 659,842,897 (six hundred fifty nine million eight hundred forty two thousand eight hundred ninety seven Rupiah).

PPG berisiko tidak akan memperoleh pengembalian tagihan secara penuh yang jumlahnya sebesar Rp 659,842,897,- (enam ratus lima puluh sembilan juta delapan ratus empat puluh dua ribu delapan ratus sembilan puluh tujuh Rupiah).

Follow-up
Tindak Lanjut

From 2022 to date, the liquidation process has been stalled due to a lack of available funds. The liquidation team is still working to resolve PPG's claim and is awaiting the sale of Himalaya Insurance's head office located at MTH Square, 3B floor, JI. MT Haryono, East Jakarta, to secure the necessary funds.

Dari sejak tahun 2022 hingga saat ini, proses likuidasi atas asset Asuransi Himalaya terhenti karena kurangnya dana yang tersedia. Tim likuidasi masih terus mengusahakan penyelesaian tagihan PPG dengan menunggu terjualnya kantor pusat Asuransi Himalaya yang berlokasi di MTH Square, lantai 3B, JI. MT Haryono, Jakarta Timur, untuk memperoleh dana yang diperlukan.

## 2. Henny Puspawati

Case Status
Status Perkara

PPG entered into a Lease Agreement with Mrs. Henny Puspawati for warehouse rental as documented in Deed No. 1 dated October 1, 2015 made before Yuasri, S.H., Notary in Yogyakarta ("Lease Agreement"). Under the Lease Agreement, PPG was required to pay IDR 1,175,000,000 (one billion one hundred seventy five million Rupiah) for the first five-year lease, which PPG has paid in full. However, it was later discovered that the warehouse's License to Build (Izin Membangun Bangunan) did not comply with its intended use, rendering the warehouse unusable by PPG. PPG has requested Mrs. Henny Puspawati to refund the warehouse lease fee paid by PPG in the amount of IDR 1,175,000,000 (one billion one hundred seventy five million Rupiah). This amount has been mutually agreed upon by PPG and Mrs. Henny as stated in the Rental Fee Repayment Agreement dated April 2, 2019 ("Rental Fee Repayment Agreement"). Under the Rental Fee Repayment Agreement, Mrs. Henny Puspawati committed to returning the full rental fee upon the sale of her land and villa in Bali under Certificate of Ownership No. 2309 ("Villa"). However, to date, PPG has not received the refund as Mrs. Henny Puspawati's Villa has yet to be sold.

PPG telah menandatangani Perjanjian Sewa Menyewa dengan Ibu Henny Puspawati untuk penyewaan sebuah gudang sebagaimana tercantum dalam Akta No. 1 tanggal 1 Oktober 2015, dibuat di hadapan Yuasri, S.H., Notaris di Yogyakarta ("Perjanjian Sewa"). Berdasarkan Perjanjian Sewa, PPG diharuskan membayar Rp 1,175,000,000,- (satu milyar seratus tujuh puluh lima juta Rupiah) untuk masa sewa lima tahun pertama yang telah dibayarkan secara penuh. Namun, dalam pelaksanaannya ditemukan bahwa Izin Mendirikan Bangunan yang dimiliki gudang yang disewakan dalam Perjanjian Sewa tidak sesuai dengan peruntukannya, sehingga gudang tersebut tidak dapat digunakan oleh PPG. PPG telah meminta kepada Ibu Henny Puspawati untuk mengembalikan biaya sewa yang telah dibayarkan oleh PPG, yakni sebesar Rp 1,175,000,000,- (satu milyar seratus tujuh puluh lima juta Rupiah). Jumlah tersebut telah disepakati oleh PPG dan Ibu Henny Puspawati sebagaimana tercantum di dalam Perjanjian Pengembalian Uang Sewa tanggal 2 April 2019 ("Perjanjian Pembayaran Kembali Biaya Sewa"). Dalam Perjanjian Pembayaran Kembali Biaya Sewa, Ibu Henny Puspawati berkomitmen untuk mengembalikan biaya sewa tersebut sepenuhnya setelah tanah dan vila Ibu Henny Puspawati di Bali dibawah Setifikat Hak Milik No. 2309 ("Villa") telah terjual. Namun hingga saat ini, PPG belum menerima biaya sewa karena Villa tersebut belum terjual.

Risks Faced by the Company and the Impact on the Company Risiko yang Dihadapi dan Pengaruhnya terhadap Perseroan

PPG will only receive a full refund of the paid warehouse lease fee in the amount of IDR 1,175,000,000 (one billion one hundred seventy five million Rupiah) if Mrs. Henny Puspawati's Villa has been sold.

PPG hanya akan memperoleh pengembalian biaya sewa gudang secara penuh sebesar Rp 1,175,000,000 (satu milyar seratus tujuh puluh lima juta Rupiah) jika Villa milik Ibu Henny Puspawati sudah terjual.

222

Follow-up
Tindak Lanjut

Yogyakarta High Court in its Decision No. 71/PDT/2022/PT YYK dated September 22, 2022 which has acquired permanent legal force, ruled, among other things: (i) to order Mrs. Henny to fully refund to PPG the warehouse lease fee of IDR 1,175,000,000 (one billion one hundred seventy five million Rupiah); and (ii) affirm the validity and enforceability of the security confiscation of the Villa ("High Court Decision"). Based on this ruling, PPG has initiated an auction for the Villa. However, Mrs. Henny Puspawati filed a judicial review of the High Court Decision, which was subsequently rejected by the Supreme Court. PPG is currently awaiting the auction results for the Villa.

Putusan Pengadilan Tinggi Yogyakarta No. 71/PDT/2022/PT YYK tanggal 22 September 2022 yang telah berkekuatan hukum tetap, telah memutuskan antara lain, untuk memerintahkan Ibu Henny Puspawati untuk membayar pengembalian biaya uang sewa sebesar Rp 1,175.000.000 (satu milyar seratus tujuh puluh lima juta Rupiah) kepada PPG dan menyatakan sah serta berharga sita jaminan terhadap Vila ("Putusan PT"). Atas putusan tersebut, PPG telah mengajukan lelang atas Vila tersebut. Namun, Ibu Henny Puspawati mengajukan peninjauan kembali atas Putusan PT, namun peninjauan kembali tersebut telah ditolak oleh Mahkamah Agung. Hingga saat ini, PPG masih menunggu hasil lelang atas Vila tersebut.

# 6. PT Maesindo Indonesia ("Maesindo")

Case Status
Status Perkara

PPG and PT Maesindo Indonesia entered into a Distribution Agreement ("Distribution Agreement"). In 2022, PPG decided to terminate the Distribution Agreement. Under its terms, an event of termination would require Maesindo to repurchase all remaining products at PPG's warehouses or instruct the new distributor to repurchase the products. However, Maesindo refused to repurchase all the remaining products and did not instruct its new distributor to do so either.

PPG dan Maesindo telah menandatangani sebuah Perjanjian Distribusi ("Perjanjian Distribusi"). Pada tahun 2022, PPG memutuskan untuk mengakhiri Perjanjian Distribusi tersebut. Berdasarkan ketentuan Perjanjian Distribusi, dalam hal Perjanjian Distribusi diakhiri, Maesindo wajib membeli kembali seluruh produk yang masih tersisa di gudang PPG atau memerintahkan distributor baru Maesindo untuk membeli kembali produk tersebut. Namun, Maesindo menolak untuk membeli kembali seluruh produk yang tersisa tersebut dan juga tidak memerintahkan distributor barunya untuk melakukan hal tersebut.

# Explanation of The Sustainability Strategy

Penjelasan Strategi Keberlanjutan

## Sustainability Strategy [POJK 1&4.a, GRI 2-22]

Strategi Keberlanjutan

We believe sustainability is not just a commitment but a shared responsibility. Our approach is through embedding sustainable practices into our operations to deliver long-term value for all stakeholders. By adopting widely accepted frameworks in for our sustainability metrics, we can translate our sustainability aspirations into concrete outcomes.

We continue to focus on actionable initiatives to address environmental and social challenges. We are dedicated to combating climate change and reducing environmental impacts by finding ways to improve energy efficiency and increasing the generation of renewable energy, to strengthening water conservation initiatives and switching to sustainable packaging materials, we are committed to reducing our environmental footprint. Climate change pose a serious threat to the availability and quality of our raw materials. Further, the global geopolitical condition and the weakening of the Rupiah make the importation of raw materials cost go higher. Thus we are working with local farming communities for the production of our herbal raw materials to have these become locally sourced as much as possible. We provide the necessary educational and other farming support to increase the volume and quality of their yield.

We prioritize diversity, inclusion and equal opportunities for our employees. We strive to have a high representation of women in the workforce. We have a high and gradually increasing employee satisfaction survey score which is a testament to our dedication to employee progress, engagement and welfare. We also have robust EHS and HR policies targeted at employee safety and well-being. We have launched and implemented a lot of employee-centric initiatives as we want to invest in our most precious resource, our people.

Through our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives, we empower communities by addressing their needs in healthcare, education and environmental conservation.

Our governance framework emphasizes accountability and transparency, ensuring our business decisions reflect our commitment to ethical practices. By integrating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into our operations, we continue to build trust with stakeholders and lay the groundwork for a sustainable future. At PT Soho Global Health Group, sustainability is more than a goal, it is the way forward. We continue to take meaningful steps to transform our commitments into lasting actions that benefit society and the planet.

Kami percaya bahwa keberlanjutan bukan sekadar komitmen, tetapi tanggung jawab bersama. Pendekatan kami adalah dengan menanamkan praktik berkelanjutan ke dalam operasi kami untuk memberikan nilai jangka panjang bagi semua pemangku kepentingan. Dengan mengadopsi kerangka kerja yang diterima secara luas dalam metrik keberlanjutan kami, kami mampu menerjemahkan aspirasi keberlanjutan kami menjadi hasil yang konkret.

Kami terus berfokus pada inisiatif yang dapat ditindaklanjuti untuk mengatasi tantangan lingkungan dan sosial. Kami berdedikasi untuk memerangi perubahan iklim dan mengurangi dampak lingkungan dengan menemukan cara untuk meningkatkan efisiensi energi dan meningkatkan pembangkitan energi terbarukan, untuk memperkuat inisiatif konservasi air dan beralih ke bahan kemasan yang berkelanjutan, kami berkomitmen untuk mengurangi jejak lingkungan kami. Perubahan iklim menjadi ancaman serius bagi ketersediaan dan kualitas bahan baku kami. Selain itu, kondisi geopolitik global dan melemahnya nilai tukar Rupiah membuat biaya impor bahan baku menjadi lebih tinggi. Oleh karena itu, kami bekerja sama dengan masyarakat petani setempat untuk memproduksi bahan baku herbal kami agar dapat bersumber dari dalam negeri sebanyak mungkin. Kami menyediakan dukungan pendidikan dan dukungan pertanian lainnya yang diperlukan untuk meningkatkan volume dan kualitas hasil panen mereka.

Kami mengutamakan keberagaman, inklusi, dan kesempatan yang sama bagi karyawan kami. Kami berupaya keras untuk memiliki representasi perempuan yang tinggi di dunia kerja. Kami memiliki skor survei kepuasan karyawan yang tinggi dan terus meningkat yang merupakan bukti dedikasi kami terhadap kemajuan, keterlibatan, dan kesejahteraan karyawan. Kami juga memiliki kebijakan SDM dan EHS yang kuat yang ditujukan pada keselamatan dan kesejahteraan karyawan. Kami telah meluncurkan dan menerapkan banyak inisiatif yang berpusat pada karyawan karena kami ingin berinvestasi pada sumber daya kami yang paling berharga, yaitu karyawan kami.

Melalui inisiatif Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan (CSR), kami memberdayakan masyarakat dengan memenuhi kebutuhan mereka dalam perawatan kesehatan, pendidikan, dan pelestarian lingkungan.

Kerangka tata kelola kami menekankan akuntabilitas dan transparansi, memastikan keputusan bisnis kami mencerminkan komitmen kami terhadap praktik yang etis. Dengan mengintegrasikan prinsip-prinsip Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (ESG) ke dalam operasi kami, kami terus membangun kepercayaan dengan para pemangku kepentingan dan meletakkan dasar bagi masa depan yang berkelanjutan. Di PT Soho Global Health Group, keberlanjutan lebih dari sekadar tujuan, ini adalah jalan ke depan. Kami terus mengambil langkah-langkah yang berarti untuk mengubah komitmen kami menjadi tindakan berkelanjutan yang bermanfaat bagi masyarakat dan bumi.

# Materiality Assessment [POJK 1, GRI 3-1&2]

## Penilaian Materialitas

We recognize that sustainability is not just a responsibility, it is a vital opportunity to drive long-term value for our stakeholders, community, and the planet. Our commitment to social responsibility, environmental stewardship, and good governance is at the core of our operations and future growth. Our Sustainability Strategy outlines our path to reducing environmental impact, fostering inclusive growth, and advancing innovative solutions that support a low-carbon future. We aim to lead by example, ensuring that every action we take today contributes to a more sustainable and prosperous tomorrow and thereby glorifies God.

We conducted our materiality analysis by objectively identifying material drivers that are important to our stakeholders. This process involved reaching out to internal and external stakeholders to obtain their feedback on a range of relevant sustainability topics.

The materiality diagram below shows our key sustainability areas of focus.

Kami menyadari bahwa keberlanjutan bukan sekadar tanggung jawab, tetapi juga peluang penting untuk mendorong nilai jangka panjang bagi para pemangku kepentingan, komunitas, dan planet ini. Komitmen kami terhadap pengelolaan lingkungan, tanggung jawab sosial, dan tata kelola yang baik merupakan inti dari operasi dan pertumbuhan kami di masa mendatang. Strategi Keberlanjutan kami menguraikan jalan kami untuk mengurangi dampak lingkungan, mendorong pertumbuhan yang inklusif, dan memajukan solusi inovatif yang mendukung masa depan rendah karbon. Kami bertujuan untuk memimpin dengan memberi contoh, memastikan bahwa setiap tindakan yang kami ambil hari ini berkontribusi pada masa depan yang lebih berkelanjutan dan sejahtera dan dengan demikian memuliakan Tuhan.

Kami melakukan analisis materialitas dengan mengidentifikasi secara objektif faktor pendorong material yang penting bagi para pemangku kepentingan kami. Proses ini melibatkan upaya menghubungi pemangku kepentingan internal dan eksternal untuk memperoleh umpan balik mereka mengenai berbagai topik keberlanjutan yang relevan.

Diagram materialitas di bawah menunjukkan area fokus utama keberlanjutan kami.

![img-153.jpeg](img-153.jpeg)

243

Our materiality sustainability focus comprises of three main pillars: (a) People and Customers; (b) Business Responsibility; and (c) Ethics and Transparency, from which our five material sub-pillars were derived.

The first material and most important sustainability topic is about keeping our employees engaged and satisfied, which we plan to achieve through continuous people training and development, work-life balance initiatives, mental and wellness programs, providing a conducive and safe working environment, and providing decent and equitable compensation and benefits. We put time and resources into developing our employees to prepare them to be our ambassadors inside and outside of the work area.

The Second material topic is about providing customer satisfaction. Providing excellent service and quality products brings satisfaction to our customers. Thus, we ensure products we produce are safe and will promote better health. We ensure that our products undergo a series of diligent quality testing and checks, both internally and through any necessary external parties, including regulators. We practice going the extra mile in the service of our customers.

Our third material topic is about the culture of innovation. Creating and/or improving products that cater to what our customers need. Since lifestyle and other factors that affect the health of our customers are constantly changing, we identify and adapt to these factors for us to provide our customers with what they need in this dynamic environment.

Our fourth material topic is about responsibility to the environment. We are striving to reduce our environmental footprint from our operational activities by reducing our waste and utility usage. We continue to develop initiatives to monitor and reduce our emissions toward a net-zero future.

Our fifth material topic is about strong good governance. We educate and train all our people about the Code of Ethics and Business Conduct to prepare them for how to properly act in the face of moral dilemmas. We provide a reporting platform (whistleblowing hotline) where actual and suspected violations can be reported without worry of retaliation. We established and socialized policies on best practices which are we expect from our employees and counter parties.

The above materiality pillars are specifically identified and aligned with our specific short-term and long-term business goals. By focusing these materiality pillars, we would be able to achieve our sustainable business goals.

Fokus keberlanjutan materialitas kami terdiri dari tiga pilar utama: (a) Karyawan dan Pelanggan; (b) Tanggung Jawab Bisnis; (c) Etika dan Transparansi, yang darinya lima sub-pilar material kami diturunkan.

Topik keberlanjutan material pertama dan yang paling penting adalah tentang menjaga keterlibatan dan kepuasan karyawan, yang kami rencanakan untuk dicapai melalui pelatihan dan pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang berkelanjutan, inisiatif keseimbangan kehidupan kerja, program kesehatan mental, menyediakan lingkungan kerja yang kondusif dan aman, menyediakan kompensasi dan tunjangan yang layak dan adil. Kami meluangkan waktu dan sumber daya untuk mengembangkan karyawan kami guna mempersiapkan mereka menjadi duta kami di dalam dan luar area kerja.

Topik materi kedua adalah tentang kepuasan pelanggan. Memberikan layanan yang sangat baik dan produk berkualitas mendatangkan kepuasan bagi pelanggan kami. Dengan demikian, kami memastikan produk yang kami hasilkan aman dan akan meningkatkan kesehatan. Kami memastikan bahwa produk kami menjalani serangkaian pengujian dan pemeriksaan kualitas yang cermat, baik secara internal maupun melalui pihak eksternal yang diperlukan, termasuk regulator. Kami berlatih untuk memberikan layanan ekstra kepada pelanggan kami.

Topik materi ketiga kami adalah tentang budaya inovasi. Menciptakan dan/atau meningkatkan produk yang memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan kami. Karena gaya hidup dan faktor-faktor lain yang memengaruhi kesehatan atau pelanggan kami terus berubah, kami mengidentifikasi dan mengadopsi faktor-faktor ini agar kami dapat menyediakan apa yang dibutuhkan pelanggan kami dalam lingkungan yang dinamis.

Topik materi keempat kami adalah tentang tanggung jawab terhadap lingkungan. Kami berupaya mengurangi jejak lingkungan dari aktivitas operasional kami dengan mengurangi limbah dan penggunaan utilitas. Kami terus mengembangkan inisiatif untuk memantau dan mengurangi emisi kami menuju masa depan tanpa emisi.

Topik materi kelima kami adalah tentang tata kelola yang baik dan kuat. Kami mendidik dan melatih semua karyawan kami tentang Kode Etik dan Perilaku Bisnis untuk mempersiapkan mereka dan bagaimana bertindak dengan benar dalam menghadapi dilema moral. Kami menyediakan platform pelaporan (hotline pengaduan pelanggaran) di mana pelanggaran aktual dan dugaan pelanggaran dapat dilaporkan tanpa khawatir akan pembalasan. Kami menetapkan dan mensosialisasikan kebijakan tentang praktik terbaik yang kami harapkan dari karyawan dan mitra kerja kami.

Pilar materialitas di atas diidentifikasi secara spesifik dan diselaraskan dengan tujuan bisnis jangka pendek dan jangka panjang kami yang spesifik. Dengan memfokuskan pilar materialitas ini, kami akan mampu mencapai tujuan bisnis berkelanjutan kami.

# Challenges and Actions Towards Sustainability Implementation [POJK 4.b & 5.e]

Tantangan dan Tindakan Menuju Implementasi Keberlanjutan

As our production levels are projected to grow, achieving our total waste and carbon reduction target becomes a challenge. This increase in production level comes with the corresponding increase in energy consumption. We perform constant facility and equipment maintenance in order to ensure that emissions from our facilities and equipment are at the minimum.

We are also performing a pre-treatment process to reduce our Hazardous Waste output. Our pre-treatment activities resulted in a significant reduction of our toxic waste output.

Another big challenge in our sustainability journey is data gathering. There is so much data that needs to be gathered and processed. Thus, coordination with different business units is also very time consuming. Ample education and socialization are very important in order to facilitate smoother discussions by having all the data contributors be on the same page with the coordinators.

Karena tingkat produksi kami diproyeksikan untuk tumbuh, mencapai target pengurangan total limbah dan karbon kami menjadi sebuah tantangan. Peningkatan tingkat produksi ini disertai dengan peningkatan konsumsi energi yang sesuai. Kami melakukan pemeliharaan fasilitas dan peralatan secara konstan untuk memastikan bahwa emisi fasilitas dan peralatan kami seminimal mungkin.

Kami juga sedang melakukan proses pra-pengolahan untuk mengurangi keluaran limbah Bahan Beracun Berbahaya (B3) kami. Kegiatan pra-pengolahan kami menghasilkan pengurangan yang signifikan dari keluaran limbah beracun kami.

Tantangan besar lainnya dalam perjalanan keberlanjutan kami adalah pengumpulan data. Ada begitu banyak data yang perlu dikumpulkan dan diproses. Dengan demikian, koordinasi dengan berbagai unit bisnis juga sangat menyita waktu. Edukasi dan sosialisasi yang memadai sangat penting untuk memfasilitasi diskusi yang lebih lancar dengan memastikan semua kontributor data memiliki pemahaman yang sama dengan para koordinator.

# Sustainability Governance

## Tata Kelola Keberlanjutan

Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners Duties on Sustainable Finance [POJK 5.a, GRI 2-24]

Soho Global Health is committed to having a sound integrated corporate governance, which includes the topic of environment, social and governance. We have established an ESG Executive Committee (ESGEC), led by our CEO who supervises the execution of our ESG Management System and assesses the adequacy of resources allocated for achieving our ESG objectives and goals. Reporting to the ESGEC, is the ESG Functional Committee (ESGFC), which is led by four ESG officers who monitor and coordinate all ESG related company initiatives. Quarterly and monthly meetings are held by the ESGEC and ESGFC, respectively to discuss the status and updates of the outstanding sustainability initiatives of the group.

We have established an ESG Committee which is composed of an Executive and a Functional Committee. The former will supervise and monitor the agreed actions on our sustainability initiatives while the latter will ensure the proper and timely implementations of the agreed actions. The Functional Committee meets monthly while the Executive Committee meets quarterly to align with the Functional Committee, before the quarterly reporting and presentation to the Board.

Competencies Development for the Board of Directors regarding Sustainability [POJK 5.b, GRI 2-17]

Our Board of Directors and Commissioners attend seminars and updates on topics about building a sustainable business. Some of our board members even have experiences in implementing sustainability initiatives in other local and cross-border companies. Our board members attend or are provided with applicable sustainability training by internal and external parties to help keep them up to date with the current and emerging mega trends and regulations.

Monitor and Control of Sustainable Finance Effectivity [POJK 5.C, GRI 2-23]

We have established comprehensive policies, standard operating procedures and work instructions to have clear guidance on how we should run our businesses. These policies and procedures are reviewed and approved by all the process owners and by the corresponding board member(s) and/or the President Director. These policies and procedures are then checked for proper execution by our Internal Audit division which reports to the board on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis regarding the implementation of the policies and procedures. Internal Audit also communicates improvement areas and actions to the board for review and approval.

Some of our key policies include: (a) anti-bribery and corruption; (b) insider trading; (c) IT and infrastructure security policy; (d) personal data privacy protection; (e) marketing practices for interaction with healthcare professionals, organizations and institutions; and (f) Human Rights. These are some of the policies that we and our stakeholders should uphold.

Tugas Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris di Bidang Keuangan Berkelanjutan [POJK 5.a, GRI 2-24]

Soho Global Health berkomitmen untuk memiliki tata kelola perusahaan terintegrasi yang sehat, yang mencakup topik lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola. Kami telah membentuk Komite Eksekutif ESG (ESGEC), yang dipimpin oleh CEO kami yang mengawasi pelaksanaan Sistem Manajemen ESG kami dan menilai kecukupan sumber daya yang dialokasikan untuk mencapai tujuan dan sasaran ESG kami. Melaporkan ke ESGEC, adalah ESG Functional Committee (ESGFC), yang dipimpin oleh empat petugas ESG yang memantau dan mengkoordinasikan semua inisiatif perusahaan terkait ESG. Pertemuan triwulanan dan dua bulanan masing-masing diadakan oleh ESGEC dan ESGFC untuk membahas status dan pembaruan inisiatif keberlanjutan yang sedang berlangsung di dalam grup.

Kami telah membentuk Komite ESG yang terdiri dari Komite Eksekutif dan Fungsional. Yang pertama akan mengawasi dan memantau tindakan yang disepakati dalam inisiatif keberlanjutan kami, sementara yang kedua akan memastikan implementasi yang tepat dan tepat waktu dari tindakan yang disepakati. Komite Fungsional bertemu setiap bulan sedangkan Komite Eksekutif bertemu setiap triwulan untuk menyelaraskan dengan Komite Fungsional, sebelum pelaporan dan presentasi triwulanan kepada Dewan.

Pengembangan Kompetensi Pengurus Direksi tentang Keberlanjutan [POJK 5.b, GRI 2-17]

Dewan Direksi dan Komisaris kami menghadiri seminar dan update topik mengenai membangun bisnis berkelanjutan. Beberapa anggota dewan kami bahkan memiliki pengalaman dalam menerapkan inisiatif keberlanjutan di perusahaan lokal dan lintas negara lainnya. Anggota dewan kami menghadiri atau diberikan pelatihan keberlanjutan yang berlaku dari pihak internal dan eksternal untuk membantu mereka tetap mengikuti perkembangan tren besar dan peraturan saat ini dan yang sedang berkembang.

Pemantauan dan Pengendalian Efektivitas Keuangan Berkelanjutan [POJK 5.C, GRI 2-23]

Kami telah menetapkan kebijakan yang komprehensif, prosedur operasi standar dan instruksi kerja untuk memiliki panduan yang jelas tentang bagaimana kami harus menjalankan bisnis kami. Kebijakan dan prosedur ini ditinjau dan disetujui oleh semua pemilik proses dan oleh anggota dewan terkait dan/atau Direktur Utama. Kebijakan dan prosedur ini kemudian diperiksa untuk pelaksanaan yang tepat oleh divisi Internal Audit kami yang melapor ke dewan secara bulanan, triwulanan dan tahunan mengenai implementasi kebijakan dan prosedur. Audit Internal juga mengkomunikasikan area perbaikan dan tindakan kepada dewan untuk ditinjau dan disetujui.

Beberapa kebijakan utama kami meliputi: (a) anti suap dan korupsi; (b) perdagangan orang dalam; (c) teknologi dan keamanan informasi; (d) perlindungan data pribadi; (e) praktik pemasaran untuk interaksi dengan profesional kesehatan, organisasi dan institusi; dan (f) Hak Asasi Manusia. Ini adalah beberapa kebijakan yang harus dijunjung tinggi oleh kami dan para pemangku kepentingan.

## Support in Handling Air Pollution

The SGH Group actively combats air pollution. SGH support includes installation of water mist generators and the provision of Tabebuya and Terminalia Catappa trees, which are capable of absorbing air pollution.

## Energy Consumption from Factory

We need energy sources to carry out our production activities, including Diesel Fuel, Natural Gas, and Electricity from the State Electricity Company (PLN). Electricity from PLN is the main energy source for our operating machinery, tools, equipment, and Air Handling Units. Energy from diesel fuel is used for Electricity Generators and Fire Pumps and Natural Gas is used to operate steam boilers.

SGH Grup turut berperan aktif dalam menangani pencemaran udara. Dukungan SGH mencakup pemasangan alat penyemprot kabut air serta penyediaan pohon Tabebuya dan Ketapang kencana yang mampu menyerap polusi udara.

## Energy Use in Central Logistics and Head Office

Product distribution from the factory or regional distribution center to branches is carried out in collaboration with vendor partners who provide transportation/forwarding services. To distribute products to customers (pharmacies/ outlets/ health facilities), PPG engages transporters that have passed all emission tests by the corresponding fuel type. For Central Logistics and Head Office, indirect energy is used in the form of electricity. If there are electricity blackouts, PPG uses electric generators for backup.

## GHG (Greenhouse Gas) Emission Control in Response to Climate Change

Climate change and global warming are problems that must be addressed by everyone. To that end, Soho Global Health contributes to curbing the extreme rate of climate change. This initiative supports the Government of Indonesia's commitment after they ratified the Paris Agreement. Climate change, including greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, poses a potential risk of reducing the availability of herbal raw materials for our products. To maintain the sustainability of existing herbal raw materials from local suppliers, we continue to guide the curcuma farmers regarding climate change and sustainable ecosystem management.

## Pengendalian Emisi GRK (Gas Rumah Kaca) sebagai Tanggapan atas Perubahan Iklim

Perubahan iklim dan pemanasan global merupakan masalah yang harus ditanggulangi oleh seluruh elemen masyarakat. Untuk itu, Soho Global Health juga turut berkontribusi dalam menekan laju perubahan iklim yang ekstrim. Inisiatif ini mendukung komitmen Pemerintah Indonesia setelah meratifikasi Paris Agreement. Perubahan iklim, termasuk emisi Gas Rumah Kaca (GRK) berpotensi menurunkan ketersediaan bahan baku herbal untuk produk kami. Untuk menjaga keberlanjutan bahan baku herbal yang ada dari pemasok lokal, kami terus melakukan pembinaan kepada para petani temulawak mengenai perubahan iklim dan pengelolaan ekosistem yang berkelanjutan.

We ensure that the management of all direct emissions from boiler operations, machine production and standby generators always comply with regulatory requirements. This is achieved by conducting routine tool maintenance, regular emission levels testing, and reporting to the Environment Agency every six months. Our initiatives to reduce GHG emissions also includes planning initiatives for the renewable energy mix to make it cleaner, more sustainable, and free from carbon emissions. Tree planting and landscape greening in the factory areas also contribute to absorbing $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ from the surrounding environment.

Kami memastikan bahwa pengelolaan semua emisi langsung dari operasi boiler, mesin produksi, dan generator siaga selalu memenuhi peraturan saat ini. Hal ini dicapai dengan mempertahankan penggunaan alat yang tepat, pengujian tingkat emisi secara teratur, dan pelaporan ke Badan Lingkungan Hidup setiap enam bulan sekali. Inisiatif kami untuk mengurangi emisi GRK juga mencakup perencanaan inisiatif pengunaan energi terbarukan agar lebih bersih, lebih berkelanjutan, dan bebas dari emisi karbon. Penanaman pohon dan penghijauan lanskap di area pabrik juga berkontribusi dalam menyerap $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ dari lingkungan sekitar.

# Waste Management [POJK 6.e, GRI 306-2]

Our waste is managed based on the type and material content, which is comprised of solid and liquid waste, hazardous, toxic, and non-hazardous materials. Our waste management is carried out in collaboration with licensed third parties.

Liquid waste is managed through the Wastewater Management Installation (IPAL). We ensure that run-off water meets Government established quality standards before being released into bodies of water or channeled for further processing by industrial estate managers. Wastewater quality monitoring is carried out internally and externally and involves an environmental laboratory accredited by the National Accreditation Committee (NAC) and registered with the Ministry of Environment and Forestry (MoEF). Their inspection results are routinely reported to the City/District Environmental Agency, the Provincial Environmental Management Agency and the MoEF.

The management of non-hazardous material solid waste follows the 3R principle: reduce, reuse, and recycle. The hazardous material waste management is entrusted to third parties authorized by the MoEF by the applicable regulations. Business units participating in the PROPER Program use an electronic-based hazardous material waste reporting system making the traceability process easier and more accurate.

# Penanganan limbah [POJK 6.e, GRI 306-2]

Limbah kami dikelola berdasarkan jenis dan kandungan bahannya, meliputi limbah padat dan cair, serta Bahan Berbahaya dan Beracun (B3), dan bukan B3. Pengelolaan limbah kami dilakukan secara mandiri, atau bekerja sama dengan pihak ketiga yang memiliki izin.

Limbah cair dikelola melalui Instalasi Pengolahan Air Limbah (IPAL). Kami memastikan bahwa air limpasan memenuhi kualitas yang ditetapkan. Pemerintah baku sebelum dibuang ke badan air, atau dialirkan untuk diproses lebih lanjut oleh pengelola kawasan industri. Pemantauan kualitas air limbah dilakukan secara internal dan eksternal dan melibatkan laboratorium lingkungan yang terakreditasi oleh Komite Akreditasi Nasional (KPA) dan terdaftar di Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan (KLHK). Hasil pengawasan mereka secara rutin dilaporkan ke Kota/Kabupaten Badan Lingkungan Hidup dan Badan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup Provinsi dan KLHK.

Pengelolaan limbah padat bukan B3 mengikuti prinsip 3R: mengurangi, menggunakan kembali, dan mendaur ulang. Pengelolaan limbah B3 dipercayakan kepada pihak ketiga yang diberi wewenang oleh KLHK sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Unit bisnis yang berpartisipasi dalam Program PROPER menggunakan sistem pelaporan limbah B3 berbasis elektronik, sehingga proses penelusuran lebih mudah dan lebih akurat.

# Efforts to Reduce Waste [POJK 6.d&e, GRI 306-3]

Hazardous waste management is conducted through a Waste Management Procedure (procedure for handling hazardous and non-hazardous waste, starting from the handover of waste generators, storage of waste, handover to third parties, and emergency handling). All operational activities within the Hazardous Waste Temporary Storage are monitored through the Waste Balance Sheet Reports and Waste Record. This is to ensure that the amount of incoming hazardous waste matches the amount of hazardous waste handed over to a waste management agency that has a permit from the Ministry of Environment and Forestry. The Waste Balance is an integral part of mandatory reporting to the Ministry as part of environmental compliance. The initial processing of the waste generated and the optimization of the production process also contributes to reducing the hazardous waste produced (pre-treatment, crushing, washing, compressing and as a mixture for animal food).

# Upaya Mengurangi Limbah [POJK 6.d&e, GRI 306-3]

Pengelolaan limbah B3 dilakukan melalui Prosedur Pengelolaan Limbah (Prosedur penanganan limbah B3, mulai dari serah terima penghasil limbah, penyimpanan limbah, serah terima ke pihak ketiga, dan penanganan darurat). Seluruh kegiatan operasional di Tempat Penimbunan Sementara Limbah B3 dipantau melalui Laporan Neraca Limbah dan Pencatatan Limbah. Hal ini untuk memastikan jumlah limbah B3 yang masuk sesuai dengan jumlah limbah B3 yang dikeluarkan ke badan pengelola limbah yang memiliki izin dari Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan. Neraca Limbah merupakan bagian integral dari pelaporan wajib kepada Kementerian sebagai bagian dari kepatuhan lingkungan. Pengolahan awal limbah yang dihasilkan dan optimalisasi proses produksi juga berkontribusi dalam pengurangan limbah B3 yang dihasilkan (pre-treatment, crushing, washing, compressing, dan sebagai campuran makanan hewani).

The research and development department continues to carry out innovative initiatives to develop environmentally friendly products. Such as removing leaflets and just putting all the necessary product information on the product packaging. This initiative has been implemented for several new products since its launching. This had a big impact in terms of reducing paper use, including the amount of waste produced. We also ensure that the secondary packaging (box) that we used also has an FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) certificate, which means it is sourced from sustainable raw materials and managed responsibly.

The Production Department has made improvements in the process of filling tablets into bottles by replacing sensors and sharpening the knife that cuts the desiccant packaging, thereby reducing the occurrence of machine stops during the bottle-filling process.

Improvement efforts were also made in the process of installing envelopes on the strip by retrofitting the envelope machine and adjusting the envelope dimensions to minimize rejects and increase product yields.

Other departments, such as Quality Control and Quality Assurance are also contributing to support waste reduction. Simplification of the analysis process to speed up analysis time and reduce the use of reagents (less waste) and energy usage.

Other improvements include reducing the use of paper by developing digitalization systems, such as Change Control System (ICCS - Integrated Change Control System), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), Calibration and Reagent Inventory Management System (Quality Laboratory Inventory System - Q-LIS) and Deviation Report Integrated System.

Departemen penelitian dan pengembangan terus melakukan inisiatif inovatif mengembangkan produk ramah lingkungan. Seperti melepas brosur dan hanya mencantumkan semua informasi produk yang diperlukan pada kemasan produk. Inisiatif ini telah diterapkan pada beberapa produk baru sejak peluncurannya. Hal ini berdampak besar dalam hal pengurangan penggunaan kertas, termasuk jumlah sampah yang dihasilkan. Kami juga memastikan bahwa kemasan sekunder (box) yang kami gunakan juga memiliki sertifikat FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) yang artinya bersumber dari bahan baku yang berkelanjutan dan dikelola secara bertanggung jawab.

Departemen Produksi telah melakukan perbaikan dalam proses pengisian tablet ke dalam botol dengan mengganti sensor dan menajamkan pisau untuk memotong kemasan dessicant sehingga mengurangi kejadian mesin berhenti saat proses filling botol.

Upaya perbaikan juga dilakukan pada proses pemasangan amplop pada strip dengan cara retrofit mesin envelope dan pengaturan dimensi envelope agar dapat meminimalisir reject dan meningkatkan rendemen produk.

Departemen lain, seperti Quality Control dan Quality Assurance juga memiliki kontribusi untuk mendukung pengurangan limbah. Penyederhanaan proses analisis juga dapat mempercepat waktu analisis dan mengurangi penggunaan reagen (lebih sedikit limbah) dan penggunaan energi.

Perbaikan lainnya juga mengurangi penggunaan kertas melalui pengembangan sistem digitalisasi, seperti Sistem Pengendalian Perubahan (ICCS - Integrated Change Control System), Sistem Manajemen Informasi Laboratorium (LIMS), Kalibrasi dan Manajemen Inventori Reagen (Q-LIS) dan Sistem Pelaporan Penyimpangan.

## Product Life Cycle Management [POJK 6.d&e]

As a herbal and supplement products production company, we understand the potential environmental impact from the entire product life cycle, including the waste from product packaging that is not reused. Knowing this, we opt to use molded paper packaging from recycled materials.

Our Research & Development is continuously innovating on designing more environmentally friendly product packaging while maintaining packaging and product quality.

## Biodiversity Protection [POJK 6.e]

Our facilities operate in an industrial area, which is designated for commercial activities, so they are not located in areas with high biodiversity. Based on a potential environmental impact mapping study in the Environmental Permit Document, showed that our business activities do not directly threaten biodiversity. Nevertheless, we support efforts to protect biodiversity.

## Manajemen Siklus Hidup Produk [POJK 6.d&e]

Sebagai perusahaan yang memproduksi produk herbal dan suplemen, kami memahami potensi dampak lingkungan dari keseluruhan siklus hidup produk, termasuk limbah dari kemasan produk yang tidak digunakan kembali. Mengetahui hal ini, kami memilih untuk menggunakan kemasan kertas cetakan dari bahan daur ulang.

Penelitian & Pengembangan kami terus berinovasi merancang kemasan produk yang lebih ramah lingkungan, dengan tetap menjaga kemasan dan kualitas produk.

## Perlindungan Keanekaragaman Hayati [POJK 6.e]

Fasilitas kami beroperasi di kawasan industri atau kawasan yang diperuntukkan bagi kegiatan komersial, sehingga tidak berada di kawasan dengan keanekaragaman hayati yang tinggi. Berdasarkan kajian pemetaan potensi dampak lingkungan dalam Dokumen Izin Lingkungan menunjukkan bahwa kegiatan usaha kami tidak secara langsung mengancam keanekaragaman hayati. Namun demikian, kami mendukung upaya untuk melindungi keanekaragaman hayati.

## II. Activities with/for the Community / Kegiatan dengan/untuk Komunitas [POJK 6c]

### Serving Our Stakeholders

We believe that providing the best services to our stakeholders creates positive resonating impacts that will ultimately cycle back to the Group.

### Access to Health care

People in many areas in Indonesia still do not have access to basic medical care, even though the need is high.

As a national-leading healthcare company, we recognize our responsibility to improve access to healthcare for the Indonesian population. Through our Professional Products and Consumer Health divisions, we reach people across the country with our products and solutions.

### Melayani Pemangku Kepentingan Kami

Kami percaya bahwa memberikan layanan terbaik kepada pemangku kepentingan kami akan membuat dampak positif yang akhirnya akan kembali ke Grup.

### Memperluas Akses Kesehatan

Banyak orang di berbagai wilayah di Indonesia masih belum memiliki akses ke layanan kesehatan dasar, meskipun kebutuhannya sangat tinggi.

Sebagai perusahaan layanan kesehatan terkemuka berskala nasional, kami percaya bahwa kami memiliki tanggung jawab untuk meningkatkan akses layanan kesehatan bagi masyarakat Indonesia. Kami menjangkau masyarakat di seluruh negeri melalui produk dan solusi dari divisi Produk Profesional dan Kesehatan Konsumen kami.

As part of our purpose, mission, and business strategy, we address critical medical needs while expanding access to our products and services in both the prescription and over-the-counter sectors. Through various programs conducted throughout the year, we strive to enhance healthcare access and improve people's health and well-being.

- Health education for the public. We regularly educate the public in collaboration with health experts and the media. These educational initiatives are conducted both online (via webinars) and offline.
- Product donations to support stunting intervention. We regularly donate products to local communities and organizations, including orphanages, to help combat malnutrition. Our efforts include providing children with vitamins and educating communities and organizations on stunting prevention.

Our recent collaboration with the Community Health Center (Puskesmas) Pulogadung in East Jakarta, supports the Government's National Stunting Rate Reduction Target. We participated in a program that distributes vitamins and health supplements to hundreds of children in the East Jakarta area, near our head office and plant.

SGH also continued its collaboration with Nagrak District, Sukabumi, an area near the SCEHR research and plantation facilities. SGH's contribution was showcased through the provision of stunting intervention assistance, including processed supplementary food (PMT), donations of Curcuma Plus milk, and health education support.

Sebagai bagian dari tujuan, misi, dan strategi bisnis kami, kami menangani kebutuhan medis yang penting sambil memperluas akses ke produk dan layanan kami di sektor resep dan obat bebas. Melalui berbagai program yang dilakukan sepanjang tahun, kami bertujuan untuk meningkatkan akses ke layanan kesehatan serta meningkatkan kesehatan dan kesejahteraan masyarakat.

- Edukasi kesehatan untuk masyarakat. Kami secara rutin mengedukasi masyarakat bekerja sama dengan pakar kesehatan dan media. Edukasi dilakukan secara online (webinar) dan offline.
- Donasi produk untuk mendukung intervensi stunting. Kami juga secara rutin mendonasikan produk kepada komunitas lokal dan organisasi, termasuk panti asuhan, di mana kami berupaya mengatasi masalah gizi buruk dengan memberikan vitamin kepada anak-anak serta mengedukasi komunitas dan organisasi tentang pencegahan stunting.

Kolaborasi terkini kami dengan Puskesmas Pulogadung, Jakarta Timur, mendukung Target Penurunan Angka Stunting Nasional Pemerintah dengan berpartisipasi dalam program pendistribusian vitamin dan suplemen kesehatan kepada ratusan anak di wilayah Jakarta Timur, lokasi yag dekat dengan kantor pusat dan pabrik kami.

SGH juga melanjutkan kolaborasi dengan Kecamatan Nagrak, Sukabumi, wilayah yang berdekatan dengan fasilitas penelitian dan perkebunan SCEHR. Kontribusi SGH ditunjukkan melalui pemberian bantuan intervensi stunting, seperti pemberian makanan tambahan (PMT), donasi susu Curcuma Plus, dan dukungan edukasi kesehatan.

Believing in the Power of Education

Education has long been recognized as a powerful tool for personal growth, empowerment, and societal progress. It not only equips individuals with knowledge and skills but also has the potential to transform perspectives and open new doors of opportunity. That is why we support educational programs that empower young people to explore a world of possibilities.

In 2023-2024, we continued supporting local education projects, including our collaboration with the "Sahabat Lingkungan Hidup" Foundation ("Eco Camp") to sponsor a green campaign called "Berkawan Dengan Alam", among others.

## Care for the earth program: SGH x Eco Camp encourage children to be friends with nature and love the earth

Every mother hopes for her child to grow up healthy and reach their full potential. In addition to balanced nutrition, children also need a clean, healthy, and comfortable environment to support their optimal growth and development.

Therefore, SOHO Global Health encourages children to care for and love the environment through its collaboration with Eco Camp, a foundation under "Yayasan Sahabat Lingkungan Hidup". Eco Camp organizes a variety of environmentally focused activities, including education, conservation, research, community empowerment, and other creative initiatives. SGH has been supporting Eco Camp since 2014 and remains committed to providing ongoing support each year.

Through the Befriend with Nature program, SGH and Eco Camp are continuing their environmental campaign in 2024, aiming to instill environmental awareness in children. This program engages early childhood education institutions and communities to promote sustainable ecosystems in both schools and households.

## Befriend with Nature 2023/2024: The Great Children Take Care of The Earth

During its activation period from August 2023 to May 2024, the Befriend with Nature program successfully reached 14,972 children and an equal number of mothers, achieving 75% of its target goal. Despite challenges posed by Ramadan and the election period, the program continued with enthusiastic and active participation in various environmental education activities. From August to September 2024, the program continued, engaging an additional 5,154 children and mothers.

This initiative involved 681 schools and successfully organized 20 Big Bang events across DKI Jakarta, West Java, Central Java, and East Java, reaching a total of 20,126 children and mothers. Throughout the program, Big Bang events provided opportunities for children and their parents to engage in interactive environmental education activities. The main activities included environmental education through games and creative hands-on experiences, such as planting, waste management, and ecological aesthetics.

## Mendukung Pentingnya Edukasi

Edukasi telah lama diakui sebagai alat yang kuat untuk pertumbuhan individu, pemberdayaan, dan kemajuan masyarakat. Edukasi tidak hanya membekali individu dengan pengetahuan dan keterampilan, tetapi juga memiliki potensi untuk mengubah perspektif dan membuka pintu menuju peluang baru. Itulah sebabnya kami mendukung program edukasi untuk memungkinkan generasi muda melihat dunia penuh dengan berbagai kemungkinan.

Pada tahun 2023-2024, kami melanjutkan dukungan bagi pengembangan proyek-proyek edukatif lokal, diantaranya dengan melanjutkan kolaborasi dengan Yayasan Sahabat Lingkungan Hidup ("Eco Camp") mensponsori edukasi ekologi melalui Program Berkawan Dengan Alam.

## Program merawat bumi: SGH x Eco Camp ajak anak hebat Berkawan dengan Alam untuk sayangi bumi

Setiap ibu pasti mengharapkan buah hatinya tumbuh dengan optimal dan sehat. Selain didukung oleh nutrisi yang seimbang, anak-anak juga perlu didukung oleh lingkungan yang bersih, sehat, dan nyaman untuk memastikan pertumbuhan dan perkembangan optimal mereka.

Oleh karena itu, SOHO Global Health mendorong anak-anak untuk peduli dan mencintai lingkungan bekerja sama dengan Eco Camp, sebuah yayasan di bawah naungan "Yayasan Sahabat Lingkungan Hidup". Eco Camp memfasilitasi berbagai kegiatan berbasis lingkungan, mulai dari edukasi, konservasi, penelitian, hingga pemberdayaan masyarakat dan aktivitas kreatif lainnya. SGH telah mendukung Eco Camp sejak tahun 2014 dan akan terus melanjutkan dukungan setiap tahunnya.

Melalui program Berkawan Dengan Alam, di tahun 2024 ini SGH dan Eco Camp melanjutkan kembali aktivasi kampanye lingkungan yang mengemban misi menanamkan nilai cinta lingkungan pada anak-anak. Program ini melibatkan lembaga sekolah usia dini dan komunitas untuk menciptakan ekosistem berkelanjutan di sekolah dan rumah tangga.

## Berkawan dengan Alam 2023/2024: Anak Hebat Merawat Bumi

Pada periode aktivasi Agustus 2023 - Mei 2024, program Berkawan dengan Alam berhasil menjangkau sebanyak 14.972 anak bersama ibunya dengan jumlah yang sama, mencapai 75% dari target yang ditetapkan. Meskipun sempat terhambat pelaksanaannya di sepanjang bulan Ramadan dan masa pemilihan umum, program ini tetap dilanjutkan dengan peserta yang antusias dan aktif mengikuti berbagai kegiatan edukasi lingkungan. Pada periode aktivasi Agustus hingga September 2024, program dilanjutkan dengan tambahan peserta yang berpartisipasi sebanyak 5.154 anak dan ibu.

Kegiatan ini secara keseluruhan melibatkan 681 sekolah, dan berhasil menyelenggarakan sebanyak 20 Big Bang yang tersebar di DKI Jakarta, Jawa Barat, Jawa Tengah, dan Jawa Timur, dengan total peserta mencapai 20.126 anak dan ibu. Pada pelaksanaannya, Big Bang mengakomodasi anak-anak beserta orang tuanya untuk dapat berpartisipasi dalam aktivitas edukasi lingkungan yang interaktif. Aktivitas utama dari rangkaian kegiatan ini meliputi pendidikan lingkungan melalui permainan dan aktivitas kreatif, mencakup penanaman, pengelolaan sampah, dan estetika ekologis.

Following the successful conclusion of the Befriend with Nature 2023/2024 program in September 2024, SGH and Eco Camp are moving forward with the launch of the Befriend with Nature 2024/2025 program in November 2024, beginning with intensive teacher training sessions.

# Befriend with Nature 2024/2025: The Great Families Take Care of the Earth

The Befriend with Nature 2024/2025 program, themed "The Great Families Take Care of the Earth", aims to promote environmental awareness through collaboration among early childhood education institutions, teachers, parents, and students. One of the goals for the 2024/2025 period is to engage 16,250 children and mothers from 650 schools.

Setelah sukses menutup program Berkawan dengan Alam 2023/2024 pada September 2024, SGH dan Eco Camp melanjutkan aktivasi dengan meluncurkan program Berkawan dengan Alam 2024/2025 pada November 2024, yang diawali dengan sesi pelatihan intensif bagi para guru.

# Berkawan dengan Alam 2024/2025: Keluarga Hebat Merawat Bumi

Program Berkawan dengan Alam 2024/2025 yang bertema "Keluarga Hebat Merawat Bumi", bertujuan untuk membangun kesadaran merawat bumi melalui kolaborasi antara lembaga sekolahusia dini, guru, orang tua, dan siswa. Target pelaksanaan Berkawan dengan Alam periode 2024/2025 telah satunya adalah menggandeng 16.250 anak beserta ibu, dari 650 sekolah.

This program aims to establish a sustainable, environmentally friendly ecosystem in schools and homes. To achieve this, teachers must receive comprehensive training to understand and effectively implement the green school concept. Therefore, the Befriend with Nature program series begins with teachers training.

This program involves 150 teachers from 150 schools across various regions in West Java. The Teachers Training program took place throughout November 2024, with participants consisting of early childhood education teachers from Cirebon, Garut, and West Bandung Regency. From each of these regions, 50 teachers from 50 schools invited to participate in the training sessions at Eco Camp, Bandung.

Program ini berupaya untuk menciptakan ekosistem berkelanjutan yang ramah lingkungan di sekolah dan rumah. As part of SGH's CSR objectives to support children's literacy in Indonesia, particularly in Eastern Indonesia, SGH has been committed since 2022—and will continue in 2024 and beyond—to improving children's literacy in Sumba through the Share the Books: Hope for Sumba hope for Indonesia program.

Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia 2024: SGH collaborates with English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba and LKSA Mercy to advance literacy

SGH continues to support English learning activities in Sumba in collaboration with the English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba community in Lamboya Village, Laboya Bawa, West Sumba, through the "Share the Books: Hope for Sumba, Hope for Indonesia" program.

This English learning community for school-age children and youth in Sumba was initiated in 2018 by Roswita Asti Kulla, a humanitarian advocate and literacy activist, starting with small classes along the coastline. Today, the EGK Sumba community has reached over 1,000 children in Sumba. However, the journey to achieve the community's mission—making education accessible to all on Sumba Island—is still long.

In addition to supporting EGK Sumba, SGH also extends its support to LKSA Mercy, located in Waikabubak, West Sumba. This orphanage, home to around 25 children of various ages from Sumba, is lovingly managed by a husband-and-wife team, Pastor Petrus and Mother Debora, despite their humble circumstances. It operates under the auspices of the Rumah Junior Foundation, based in Jakarta, which is dedicated to making the dreams of children in Eastern Indonesia come true by building 100 schools across the region, from Kupang and Flores to Sumba.

The year 2024 marks the third year of SGH's support for the Hope for Sumba program. Amid challenges such as limited access to West Sumba, inadequate school conditions, and limited availability of reading materials and healthcare services, the contributions from Soho Global Health (SGH) have been invaluable.

Dalam rangka memenuhi salah satu tujuan CSR SGH untuk mendukung literasi anak-anak Indonesia, khususnya di Indonesia Timur, SGH telah berkomitmen sejak 2022—dan akan terus berlanjut pada 2024 dan seterusnya—untuk mendukung peningkatan literasi anak-anak di Sumba melalui program Share the Books: Hope for Sumba hope for Indonesia.

Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia 2024: SGH berkolaborasi dengan English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba dan LKSA Mercy berjuang bersama untuk literasi

SGH kembali mendukung kegiatan belajar bahasa Inggris di Sumba bekerjasama dengan komunitas English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba di desa Lamboya, Laboya Bawa, Sumba Barat melalui program "Share the Books: Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia".

Komunitas belajar bahasa Inggris untuk anak-anak usia sekolah dan muda-mudi Sumba ini diinisiasi sejak 2018 oleh seorang penggerak kemanusiaan dan penggiat literasi, Roswita Asti Kulla, memulai dari kelas kecil di pesisir pantai, Hari ini, Komunitas EGK Sumba telah menjangkau lebih dari 1.000 anak Sumba. Namun perjuangan masih panjang untuk mewujudkan misi komunitas ini: membuat pendidikan dapat diakses secara menyeluruh di Pulau Sumba.

Selain mendukung EGK Sumba, SGH juga memberikan bantuan untuk LKSA Mercy yang berlokasi di Waikabubak, Sumba Barat. ## Community Development

Our CSR programs in community development are carried out in collaboration with various agricultural institutions, researchers, Community Health Center ("Puskesmas") and the Nagrak sub-district. These initiatives support local programs, including stunting alleviation and the Open Defecation Free (ODF) program in Nagrak Village, Sukabumi Regency, West Java —an area surrounding our herbal research facility, the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR).

In line with our commitment to creating a greater impact on the environment and society, the Sukabumi community development program goes beyond providing knowledge and cultivation methods to local temulawak farmers. It also fosters a strategic partnership aimed at sustaining economic value. We offer potential support to increase productivity and yields while ensuring long-term market access for temulawak harvest in coordination with "Gapoktan Dahlia Sukabumi". This partnership benefits SGH by securing a consistent supply of high-quality raw materials for curcuma-based products while simultaneously improving the economic well-being of local farmers near the SCEHR plantation.

# III. Activities with/for our Employees / Kegiatan dengan/untuk Karyawan kami

## Recognizing and Respecting Employees' Rights [POJK 6.c, GRI 408-1, GRI 409-1]

As a Company engaged in the healthcare industry, SGH believes that business has a responsibility to respect human rights and consistently make every effort to uphold human rights within the Company. Therefore, the Company has a policy as a guideline for all employees to respect and prioritize human rights as an inseparable right and uphold for the sake of honor and protection of human dignity in relations between employees, external parties and society.

The Company is committed to the principle that human rights violations are illegal and we have zero-tolerance for it. The company makes every effort to ensure that there is no discrimination or business practices that are contrary to human rights and takes steps to identify and prevent risks of human rights violations in business. In 2022, 2023 and 2024, there were no human rights violation case at SGH, either by employees or external parties.

The Company's efforts to protect human rights among others:

1.  Prohibition of Child Labor
The Company prohibits employing children under the age of 18 (eighteen) years, and this minimum age is used as a requirement in recruitment.

2.  Prohibition of Forced Labor and Human Trafficking
The Company prohibits all forms of forced labor practices, including forced contract workers, modern forced labor, and all forms of human trafficking.

3.  Prohibition of Harassment and Intimidation
All levels of management and Employees are prohibited from discriminating against Employees who file complaints of harassment and intimidation. The Company and its Employees are committed and responsible for preventing acts of harassment and intimidation by maintaining good and productive industrial relations, socialization of policy and regulations applicable to the Company, fair employment practices and respectful communication in the workplace.

## Mengakui dan Menghormati Hak-Hak Karyawan [POJK 6.c, GRI 408-1, GRI 409-1]

Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di industri kesehatan, SGH meyakini bahwa bisnis memiliki tanggung jawab dalam menghormati Hak Asasi Manusia (HAM) dan secara konsisten mendukung upaya-upaya penegakan HAM di lingkungan Perusahaan. Oleh karena itu perusahaan memiliki kebijakan khusus yang digunakan sebagai pedoman bagi seluruh Karyawan untuk menghormati dan mengedepankan HAM sebagai hak yang tidak terpisahkan dari manusia dan ditegakkan demi kehormatan serta perlindungan harkat dan martabat manusia dalam hubungan antar Karyawan, pihak eksternal serta masyarakat sekitar.

Perusahaan berkomitmen bahwa pelanggaran HAM merupakan tindakan ilegal dan tidak dapat ditolerir (zero-tolerance). Perusahaan berupaya maksimal untuk memastikan tidak terjadi diskriminasi ataupun praktik bisnis yang bertentangan dengan HAM, serta mengambil langkah-langkah untuk mengidentifikasi dan mencegah risiko pelanggaran HAM dalam bisnis. Pada tahun 2022, 2023 dan 2024, tidak terdapat kasus pelanggaran HAM di SGH, baik yang dilakukan oleh karyawan maupun pihak eksternal.

Langkah-langkah Perusahaan dalam melindungi HAM antara lain meliputi:

1.  Larangan Tenaga Kerja Anak
Perusahaan melarang mempekerjakan anak di bawah usia 18 (delapan belas) tahun, dan batasan usia ini dijadikan sebagai syarat minimal usia penerimaan Karyawan.

2.  Larangan Kerja Paksa dan Jual Beli Manusia
Perusahaan melarang segala bentuk praktek kerja paksa, termasuk tenaga kontrak paksa, model perbudakan modern dan segala bentuk jual beli manusia.

3.  Larangan Tindakan Pelecehan dan Intimidasi
Seluruh jajaran manajemen dan Karyawan dilarang melakukan diskriminasi terhadap Karyawan yang mengajukan pengaduan terjadinya tindakan Pelecehan dan Intimidasi. Perusahaan dan karyawan berkomitmen dan bertanggung jawab untuk mencegah terjadinya tindakan pelecehan dan intimidasi dengan cara menjaga hubungan industrial yang baik dan produktif, sosialisasi kebijakan dan peraturan yang berlaku di Perusahaan, praktik ketenagakerjaan yang adil dan komunikasi penuh hormat di tempat kerja.

The Company is also committed to respecting labor rights as a manifestation of human rights for employees, namely:

Perusahaan juga berkomitmen dalam menghormati hak-hak ketenagakerjaan sebagai salah satu perwujudan HAM bagi karyawan, yaitu:

a. Memenuhi hak ketenagakerjaan.
b. Menghormati hubungan kerja dengan Karyawan, khususnya dalam hal kejelasan status Karyawan, penempatan kerja, penerimaan karyawan baru, mutasi, rotasi, promosi, dan demosi.
c. Menghormati hak Karyawan untuk memiliki kesehatan yang baik, hari dan jam kerja yang jelas, kesempatan untuk cuti sakit, cuti haid, melahirkan, keguguran, cuti bersama, dan cuti tahunan.
d. Memberikan kesempatan yang setara dan non-diskriminatif serta menghargai keberagaman dan perbedaan.

## SGH Group Wellness Program

The Company believes that physical fitness is important to support employee health, so they remain fit at work. Therefore, on April 26, 2024 the Company launched a health program called the "SGH Wellness Program", located at the SGH Group Head Office, Jakarta. Mr. Rogelio Paulino Jr. Castillo Lao as President Director & CEO said that regular exercise is important to maintain and increase heart rate so that the body's metabolism is well maintained.

The launch event of SGH Wellness Program was attended and supported by all levels of SGH's Group Management and also attended by employee representatives from each Department/Division/Unit located at the Head Office.

## Program Kesehatan SGH Grup

Perusahaan percaya bahwa kebugaran tubuh penting untuk menunjang kesehatan Karyawan agar tetap prima dalam bekerja. Oleh karena itu, pada tanggal 26 April 2024 Perusahaan telah meluncurkan program kesehatan yang diberi nama "SGH Wellness Program", bertempat di Kantor Pusat SGH Grup, Jakarta. Bapak Rogelio Paulino Jr. Castillo Lao selaku Presiden Direktur & CEO menyampaikan bahwa olahraga rutin penting dilakukan untuk menjaga kestabilan detak jantung sehingga metabolisme tubuh terjaga dengan baik.

Acara peluncuran SGH Wellness Program ini mendapatkan dukungan dari seluruh jajaran Manajemen SGH Grup dan dihadiri pula oleh perwakilan Karyawan dari setiap Departemen/Divisi/Unit yang berlokasi di Kantor Pusat.

This event was used as a promotional event for 7 (seven) sports initiated by the employees at the Head Office, namely badminton, futsal (indoor football), pound fit, zumba, yoga, table tennis and basketball. Representatives from each sport invited employees to join sports communities that suit the respective employee's interests. Employees at branch offices also took part in the joint exercises and/or held other sport activities that are preferred by the branches to be held regularly.

The Company fully supports these activities and invites employees to take advantage of the sports activities provided by the Company, as part of the SGH Wellness Program. Apart from sports activities, various initiatives have been carried out, including:

1. Health monitoring by the Company Doctors, which can be done face to face or virtual consultations for employees and their families.
2. Providing Body Mass Index (BMI) measuring devices at Company clinics.
3. Health Talk on the SGH Webinar Series platform, by adapting topics from the main findings of periodic health examinations carried out in 2024.
4. Health education for the employees, through the Medical Talk Series which is a collaboration between the Medical Affairs team and the SGH Marketing team.

# Akreditasi Klinik Pratama PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi

Dalam upaya mempertahankan derajat kesehatan dan memastikan Karyawan dalam keadaan sehat selama bekerja, Perusahaan menyediakan Klinik Pratama PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi yang berlokasi di Jl. Pulogadung No. 6, Kawasan Industri Pulogadung, Jakarta Timur.

Visi Klinik Pratama PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi adalah menjadi pusat pelayanan kesehatan Karyawan dengan pelayanan yang prima serta menjunjung kepedulian terhadap kehidupan manusia sebagai prioritas kami yang tertinggi untuk memuliakan Tuhan Yang Maha Esa.

Misi Klinik Pratama PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi adalah:

Menyelenggarakan pelayanan kesehatan yang bermutu, dengan mengutamakan keselamatan pasien;
Memberikan pelayanan yang ramah, tanggap dan professional; dan
Menjaga kesehatan karyawan untuk mendukung kelancaran proses kegiatan Perusahaan.

Layanan Klinik Pratama adalah pelayanan medik dasar yang meliputi pertolongan pertama, konsultasi, pengobatan, vaksinasi, pelayanan kontrasepsi Keluarga Berencana, dan pemberian vitamin produk SGH Grup.

In accordance with Law Number 17 of 2023 concerning Health, and Circular Letter of the Minister of Health Number HK.02.01/MENKES/1048/2023 concerning the Implementation of Hospital Accreditation, Class D Primary Hospitals, Community Health Centers and Clinics, as well as Reporting National Quality Indicators for Places Independent Practice for Doctors and Independent Practice for Dentists, it is stated that every health service facility is obliged to continuously and sustainably improve the quality of health services. Therefore, the Company is committed to taking part in the PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi Primary Clinic accreditation survey through the Online Health Facilities Data (DFO) application which was created and managed by the Ministry of Health.

The accreditation survey is an assessment to measure the achievement and implementation of accreditation standards while determining accreditation status is the granting of an accreditation certificate based on the results of the accreditation survey. Accreditation Standards are guidelines that contain levels of achievement that must be met by health service facilities to improve service quality and patient safety.

The accreditation survey was carried out using 2 (two) methods, including hybrid or offline and online methods, and was carried out on May 13, and May 15, 2024. As a result, the PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi Primary Clinic received Primary Clinic Accreditation with the title "Plenary" from the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Indonesia. Plenary Accreditation is the highest recognition based on an assessment of health facilities, standards and ongoing service quality.

The representatives of the Board of Directors and the Doctor in-charge of the Primary Clinic of PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi and all clinic staff are committed to continuously maintaining and improving facilities, service quality and patient safety.

## c. Religious Activities

In line with the SOHO Global Health Goal (SGH) Purpose "To hold the care of human life as our highest priority, and thereby glorify God," Employees actively initiate activities in religious communities, including First Friday Mass, Prayer Meetings, and Friday Shalat.

## i. First Friday Mass

First Friday Mass is a eucharistic celebration held by Catholics every first Friday of every month. This celebration is a form of devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus.

This is a reminder for Catholic employees, especially those located at the SGH Group Head Office, to always rely on Almighty God in their work and daily life and thus dedicate all their work to glorifying God.

During 2024, First Friday Mass has been regularly held at the SGH Group Head Office located in the Jakarta Industrial Estate Pulogadung, East Jakarta.

## ii. Christian Prayer Meetings

Apart from the First Friday Mass, another religious activity held at SGH is the Prayer Fellowship, which is held once a month.

This prayer meeting is an activity for Christians to support each other, share and strengthen relationships among SGH Group employees.

Other goals include building closeness to Almighty God through joint prayer and supporting each other in prayer among fellow SGH Group employees of the same faith by reading the Bible, hearing God's words, singing praises, and giving testimonies that strengthen each other's faith.

## c. Kegiatan Keagamaan

Sejalan dengan Tujuan SOHO Global Health (SGH Purpose), yaitu "Menjunjung kepedulian terhadap kehidupan manusia sebagai prioritas kami yang tertinggi untuk memuliakan Tuhan Yang Maha Esa", Karyawan secara aktif menginisiasi aktivitas dalam komunitas keagamaan, di antaranya Misa Jumat Pertama, Persekutuan Doa, dan Shalat Jumat.

## i. Misa Jumat Pertama

Misa Jumat Pertama adalah perayaan ekaristi yang dilakukan umat Katolik setiap hari Jumat pertama di setiap bulan. Perayaan ini merupakan bentuk devosi kepada Hati Kudus Yesus.

Hal ini menjadi salah satu pengingat bagi Karyawan yang beragama Katolik, khususnya yang berlokasi di Kantor Pusat SGH Group, agar senantiasa mengandalkan Tuhan Yang Maha Esa dalam pekerjaan dan kehidupan sehari-hari, dan dengan demikian mendedikasikan seluruh pekerjaannya untuk memuliakan Tuhan.

Selama tahun 2024, Misa Jumat Pertama secara rutin diadakan di Kantor Pusat SGH Grup yang berlokasi di Kawasan Industri Pulogadung, Jakarta Timur.

## ii. Persekutuan Doa Kristen

Selain Misa Jumat Pertama, kegiatan keagamaan lainnya yang diadakan di SGH adalah Persekutuan Doa, yang dilaksanakan setiap bulan sekali.

Persekutuan doa ini merupakan kegiatan umat Kristiani untuk saling mendukung, berbagi, dan mempererat hubungan di antara karyawan SGH Grup.

Tujuan lainnya antara lain untuk membangun kedekatan dengan Tuhan Yang Maha Esa melalui doa bersama dan saling mendukung dalam doa di antara sesama Karyawan SGH Grup yang seiman dengan membaca Alkitab, mendengar firman Tuhan, menyanyikan puji-pujian, dan memberi kesaksian yang saling menguatkan iman.

# d. Employee Cooperative Activities

Employees of PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi manage the employee cooperative independently, which was established on April 1, 1984 and currently has 240 members. The Cooperative was established under the decree on June 5, 2005 with the name PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi "Setia Abadi" Employee Cooperative (Setia Abadi Cooperative).

As a form of appreciation to its members, the cooperative routinely provides Hari Raya gifts every year before Eid al-Fitr. This gift is given to members who have joined for at least one year.

Setia Abadi cooperative activities include the following:

1. Sales of various kinds of employees' daily needs, among others snacks and soft drinks, household staples, and other needs.
2. Procurement of stationery and drawing equipment to the Company.
3. Other cooperative activities.

The Setia Abadi Employees Cooperative regularly holds Annual Member Meetings as a form of transparency, accountability, and commitment to democratic principles in cooperative management. The meeting is usually attended by all cooperative administrators, members, and representatives of the Labor Union at PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi.

# d. Kegiatan Koperasi Karyawan

Karyawan PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi mengelola koperasi Karyawan secara swadaya, yang telah didirikan sejak 01 April 1984 dan saat ini beranggotakan 240 orang. Koperasi ini telah mendapat ketetapan hukum pada tanggal 05 Juni 2005 dengan nama Koperasi Karyawan PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi "Setia Abadi" (Koperasi Setia Abadi).

Sebagai bentuk apresiasi kepada anggota, koperasi secara rutin memberikan bingkisan Hari Raya setiap menjelang Hari Raya Idul Fitri. Bingkisan ini diberikan kepada anggota yang telah bergabung selama minimal satu tahun.

Kegiatan koperasi Setia Abadi antara lain sebagai berikut:

1. Penjualan berbagai macam kebutuhan harian Karyawan, berupa makanan dan minuman ringan, bahan pokok rumah tangga, serta kebutuhan lainnya.
2. Pengadaan alat tulis dan perlengkapan menggambar ke Perusahaan.
3. Kegiatan koperasi lainnya.

Koperasi Karyawan Setia Abadi secara rutin menyelenggarakan Rapat Anggota Tahunan (RAT) sebagai bentuk transparansi, akuntabilitas, dan komitmen terhadap prinsip demokrasi dalam pengelolaan koperasi. Rapat tersebut biasanya dihadiri oleh seluruh pengurus koperasi, anggota, dan perwakilan dari Serikat Pekerja Karyawan di PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi.

The agenda discussed at the annual meeting includes:

1. Submission of cooperative management accountability reports, which include financial reports, business activity reports, and achievements over the past year.
2. Presentation of the cooperative's work plan and budget for the coming year, including plans for business development and services to members.
3. Discussion of proposals, suggestions, and input from members regarding cooperative management.

The annual meeting is usually an important moment to strengthen relations between members and management, as well as strengthen joint commitment to realize the welfare of cooperative members.

# 3. Negotiations on Collective Labor Agreement of PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi for the Period of 2024 to 2026

From June to July 2024, PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi and the Reformed Pharmaceutical and Health Labor Union, PT SIP Work Unit Leaders (SP Farkes-R PT SIP) held negotiations on a Collective Labor Agreement (CLA) for the period 2024 to 2026. 2024 Employee Engagement Survey

SGH Group has consistently conducted an Employee Engagement Survey (EES) for more than 10 years, which aims to determine the level of employee engagement with the Company as well as the Employer of Choice (EoC) index. Since 2021 this survey has been carried out regularly at the end of every year to see trends by comparing to previous years.

This survey was conducted online and is anonymous, so all SGH Group employees are encouraged to participate in filling out this survey. In the 2024 survey, 2204 responses were obtained from a total of 2381 employees targeted to participate or 93% of the total population. All respondents are employees who are still actively working until December 1, 2024.

The Employer of Choice index in 2024 is 81.7%, an increase of 0.2% compared to 2023, increasing consistently over the last ten years. This indicates that employees' perception and commitment toward the Company have shown a positive improvement year over year across various assessed aspects.
